title: Content Writer (Portuguese) - 53457
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.

Role Overview:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Content Writer to create and refine content used in workflows, training data, and scenario-based evaluations for large language models (LLMs). You will help build realistic content samples, review AI-generated outputs, and ensure accuracy, clarity, and consistency.

What does day-to-day look like:

  • Create and edit content across formats such as articles, guides, workflows, and scenarios.
  • Recreate real-world content workflows for AI evaluation.
  • Review AI outputs for quality, accuracy, and adherence to guidelines.
  • Provide feedback and annotations to support LLM improvement.
  • Collaborate with product and AI teams to align content with operational needs.

Required Qualifications:

  • 2+ years experience as a Content Writer, Copywriter, or Technical Writer.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify content gaps or inconsistencies.
  • Familiarity with documentation or workflow tools (e.g., Confluence, Notion, Zendesk, Jira).
  • Excellent written communication skills.

Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.

Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : at least 4 hours per day and minimum 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 1 month

Evaluation Process :

  • Shortlisted candidates will be reviewed by our team internally and shortlisted candidates will be reached out for onboarding.

  • Integração com áreas internas e Unidade Técnica;
  • Gestão de Equipe/liderança; desenvolvimento de pessoas;
  • Gestão administrativa/operacional da área;
  • Realizar ações comerciais/campanhas, desenvolver estratégias para aumento de vendas, atrair novos clientes, fidelizar e garantir o alcance das metas estabelecidas;

O QUE A MAPFRE ESPERA DE VOCÊ

  • Superior completo;
  • Pós-graduação desejável;
  • CNH ativa;
  • Disponibilidade de horário e para viagens;
  • Vivência comercial no setor de seguros, com foco em canais digitais e parcerias estratégicas;
  • Domínio de plataformas digitais, funil de vendas, CRM, precificação, KPIs comerciais e ferramentas de BI;
  • Mandatório sólido conhecimento produto VIDA:
  • Necessária experiência em gestão de área e Equipe/Liderança (administrativa, financeira e equipe);
  • Vivência em elaboração, análise, acompanhamento e apresentação de resultados / indicadores;
  • Influência e negociação; Foco no cliente e resultado; Organização e gestão de tempo;
  • Residir em SÃO PAULO/SP;

LOCAL: BERRINI;

Nossos benefícios para você

A jornada diária conta com horário flexível, formato de trabalho híbrido, incentivo a saúde e qualidade de vida com Plano de Saúde, Assistência Odontológica, Auxílio Academia, Vale-Refeição, Vale-Alimentação, Incentivo a Previdência Privada, Day-off de aniversário, Vale-Transporte ou Fretado, PLR, condições especiais na contratação de seguros da MAPFRE, auxílio babá ou creche, Universidade Corporativa, descontos para estudos e seguro de Vida.

Nos importamos com o desenvolvimento dos nossos colaboradores e para isso, trabalhamos programas que promovem mobilidade, desenvolvimento, oportunidades de carreira e crescimento profissional. Programas de treinamento e desenvolvimento;

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Join Aerial Core - the back office that keeps pace with your ambition

Aerial Core is a modern, tech-enabled back-office partner that supports growing businesses through accounting, finance, and people operations services. We’ve intentionally broken the mold of traditional accounting firms by placing relationships, collaboration, and innovation at the center of how we work.

At Aerial Core, we believe accounting should be more than compliance, it should be strategic, insightful, and human-driven. Our people-first culture values trust, independence, and efficiency, empowering every team member to do their best work while helping clients thrive.

We’re now looking for a tech-savvy, detail-oriented Bookkeeper to join our remote team. Please be informed that this is a contractor position and we will require your CNPJ. This is the perfect opportunity for professionals who value autonomy, flexibility and performance based rewards. You’ll work directly with clients, manage their day-to-day financial operations, and leverage technology to deliver accurate, timely, and strategic bookkeeping support.

What You'll Do

  • Handle full-cycle bookkeeping for assigned clients, including AP/AR, bank reconciliations, and month-end close.
  • Maintain accurate financial data using QuickBooks or other cloud-based accounting tools.
  • Prepare clear, insightful financial reports that help clients make better decisions.
  • Communicate with clients and team members through Slack, Zoom, and Google Workspace.
  • Use Financial Cents to track projects, deliverables, and timelines.
  • Proactively identify ways to improve processes, automate tasks, and increase efficiency.
  • Prepare necessary documentation and reports for internal and external audit processes.
  • Ensure compliance with accounting standards and Aerial Core’s quality expectations.

What We're Looking For

  • Fluent in English
  • Proven experience in bookkeeping or accounting 
  • Flexibility around working hours, with the understanding that some tasks may require availability during US business hours (mainly Pacific Time)
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and accuracy
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to manage multiple clients independently
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote-first environment using digital tools.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Financial Cents or any other workflow automation tools
  • Familiarity with CRMs or project management systems such as Asana
  • Prior experience working with startups or small businesses

Why You'll Love Working With Us

At Aerial Core, we do things differently:

  • Trust and Independence: You are your own boss. We trust your expertise and give you the freedom to manage your time and workload.
  • Efficiency and Innovation: We embrace technology and encourage experimentation. If you find a better way to work, we’ll support it.
  • Collaboration and Growth: We win as a team. Our culture is built on helping each other, learning together, and celebrating shared success.
  • Performance-Driven Rewards: Your efforts directly impact your earnings. You’ll receive a retainer contract of R$3,300 with the option to qualify for more contracts. 
  • Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere, anytime as long as deadlines are met and excellence is maintained.

The Aerial Core Way

  • Relationships over Transactions: We build lasting relationships by deeply understanding our clients and delivering real value.
  • Strategic Thinking & Judgment: We go beyond the surface, identifying root causes and providing actionable insights.
  • Open Communication: We value transparency and see mistakes as opportunities for growth.
  • Excellence & Accountability: We aim for 10/10 work — delivered early, reviewed thoroughly, and executed with care.

Ready to do accounting differently?

Join a modern, digital-first team where your independence, innovation, and impact truly matter.

title: Direct Response Video Editor for 8-Figure DTC Brand
description:
Direct Response Video Editor (Remote - Brazil Preferred)

$1,200-$1,400 USD/month + $250+ Monthly Performance Bonuses

We're an 8-figure DTC beauty & wellness brand generating $1M+ in monthly revenue through high-volume, high-converting video advertising. We need an elite video editor who understands direct response mechanics and can produce scroll-stopping ads at scale.

Your work will directly drive sales across Meta, YouTube, and emerging platforms—with immediate feedback from millions of impressions monthly.

What You'll Actually Do

High-Volume Ad Production (40-60 ads/month): Transform raw creator footage, UGC clips, and b-roll into persuasive short-form ads (15-90 seconds) and VSLs that convert cold traffic into buyers. You'll work across multiple products and funnels simultaneously.

Master Direct Response Mechanics:

  • Craft hooks that stop thumbs in the first 3 seconds (pattern interrupts, bold claims, visual glitches)
  • Deploy engagement disruptors: kinetic typography, callout graphics, progress bars, emoji reactions
  • Optimize pacing for platform algorithms (Meta 9:16, YouTube Shorts)
  • A/B test visual approaches based on performance data

Post-Production Excellence Color grading, sound design, motion graphics, and seamless transitions using Premiere Pro, After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve. Your edits should feel polished but authentic—not overproduced.

Rapid Iteration & Testing Partner with our Creative Strategist to test new concepts weekly. Expect fast feedback cycles and the need to pivot based on real-time campaign data. Speed + quality = your competitive advantage here.

AI-Enhanced Workflow Leverage tools like Descript, Runway, and AI caption generators to maximize output without sacrificing quality. We value efficiency and smart automation.

Top Fits Will Have:

  • Strong level of fluent English fluency (hard requirement)
  • 2+ years editing for DTC/eCommerce brands (beauty, health, or supplements ideal)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response ads that drove conversions (show us your winners)
  • Expert-level proficiency in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve + After Effects
  • Deep understanding of Meta/YouTube Shorts specs and algorithm-friendly editing patterns
  • Native fluency with UGC aesthetics (raw, authentic, relatable) vs. polished brand content
  • Proven ability to produce 8-12 ads per week without compromising quality
  • Ability to think critically and recommend new approaches, ad formats, and tools (outside the box)

Bonus Points:

  • Experience editing short-form VSLs (2-3+ minutes) or long-form VSLs (25+ minutes)
  • Motion design skills (After Effects, Cinema 4D)
  • Understanding of direct response copywriting principles
  • Familiarity with CapCut, Descript, or AI editing tools
  • Portuguese + English fluency

Non-Negotiables:

  • Fast turnaround times (24-48 hour revisions)
  • Self-directed work ethic in a remote environment
  • Obsessive attention to detail
  • Ego-free collaboration and receptiveness to feedback

Why Top Editors Choose Us:

Transparent Compensation Base salary + monthly performance bonuses tied to ad performance metrics. Top performers earn 20-30% above base.

Career Growth Path Start as Senior Editor → Lead Editor → Creative Director as we scale. We promote from within.

See Your Impact Daily Direct access to campaign metrics. You'll know exactly which of your ads are crushing it (and which aren't).

title: Operador(a) Painel Recuperação, Evaporação e Cristalização
description:
O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Sobre a Função

Desafios:

Operar e monitorar o Sistema Digital de Controle Distribuído (SDCD) das áreas de Evaporação e Recuperação, garantindo o funcionamento seguro, eficiente e contínuo dos equipamentos e processos, assegurando a concentração do licor negro, a geração de vapor e energia, a recuperação de químicos e a minimização do impacto ambiental, seguindo procedimentos operacionais, identificando e reportando anomalias, e atuando proativamente para manter a estabilidade da produção, a eficiência energética e atendendo aos objetivos de sustentabilidade do negócio.

Principais Atividades:

  • Operar e monitorar o processo via SDCD, garantindo estabilidade e eficiência das áreas de Evaporação e Recuperação.
  • Acompanhar parâmetros de processo (temperatura, pressão, vazão, emissões etc.) e realizar ajustes necessários.
  • Executar partidas e paradas de equipamentos conforme procedimentos e padrões de segurança.
  • Identificar alarmes, anomalias e desvios operacionais, adotando ações corretivas iniciais e comunicando áreas envolvidas.
  • Registrar dados operacionais e acompanhar intervenções de manutenção, garantindo retorno seguro ao processo.
  • Manter comunicação contínua com operadores de campo, manutenção, laboratório e meio ambiente.
  • Cumprir POPs, normas de segurança (incluindo NR-13), ambientais e políticas do Sistema de Gestão Integrado.
  • Participar de análises de desvios, treinamentos técnicos e ações de melhoria contínua.
  • Zelar pelo bom funcionamento do painel SDCD e contribuir para um ambiente de trabalho seguro e colaborativo.
  • Participar de emergências conforme procedimentos, incluindo plano de emergência e brigada (quando aplicável).
  • Executar outras atividades correlatas e apoiar na atualização de procedimentos e padrões.

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Curso técnico completo em Papel e Celulose, Química, Eletrotécnica, Automação Industrial e/ou afins;
  • Desejável ensino superior em Administração, Engenharias e afins;
  • Conhecimento no Pacote Office, SAP, Ferramentas BI;
  • Vivência em Comissionamento e startup de plantas de Celulose e/ou Papel;
  • Conhecimento dos processos de Evaporação (princípios de transferência de calor, balanço de massa e energia) , Recuperação (combustão de licor negro, ciclo da água/vapor, recuperação de químicos, controle de emissões) e sistemas de tratamento de cinzas;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de controle e automação industrial, especialmente SDCD;
  • Conhecimento em Instrumentação industrial (sensores de temperatura, pressão, vazão, nível, analisadores de gases) relevantes para as áreas;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em segurança do trabalho, procedimentos de emergência, especialmente relacionados a caldeiras, vasos de pressão, espaços confinados, produtos químicos e controle de incêndio;

Our Financial Crime team blends regulatory expertise with data-driven thinking to make sure our products meet legal and policy requirements and deliver real value to customers. In a fast-moving, digital environment, they stay one step ahead by finding smart, scalable ways to prevent financial crime.

We're looking for an Intelligence Manager to reinforce our first line of defence (1LoD) FinCrime framework in Brazil and focus on complex investigations (AML, sanctions, and organised fraud).

You'll act as the core investigative expert for the Brazilian market, bringing your senior expertise to secure our operations and conduct deep-dive analyses.

Up to shape what’s next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

What you'll be doing

  • Conducting in-depth, intelligence-led investigations into high-risk money laundering, sanctions, fraud, and organised crime cases involving customers in Brazil
  • Identifying emerging ML/TF typologies across PIX, credit, retail, and business products, translating findings into actionable insights and control enhancements
  • Ensuring timely and accurate reporting to COAF and supporting MLROs with defensible SAR narratives and documentation aligned with BCB requirements
  • Escalating systemic gaps identified through investigations, raising risk incidents, and coordinating remediation with FinCrime Product and Data teams
  • Contributing to FinCrime governance forums (CRC, ERC, ExCo), providing data-backed updates on investigations, risk trends, and control effectiveness
  • Acting as an interface between CIU, global FIU, compliance assurance, and external regulators during inspections or information requests

What you'll need

  • 7+ years of experience leading complex AML and fraud investigations within a financial institution or fintech, including exposure to layering, scams, synthetic identities, and organised crime
  • A solid understanding of BCB and COAF frameworks, including SAR requirements, sanctions, and fraud-reporting obligations
  • Experience identifying systemic gaps, raising risk incidents, and designing remediation plans across AML and fraud controls
  • Expertise in reading and interpreting transaction data (PIX, credit, card, business), using Looker, SQL, or equivalent tools to detect typologies and outliers
  • The ability to prepare clear, defensible reports and narratives for regulatory filings and internal governance forums
  • To be able to explain complex AML/fraud findings to non-technical audiences, senior management, and regulators

Nice to have

  • The ability to perform deep data exploration using SQL, Python, or visualisation tools (Looker, Power BI) to detect typologies or anomalies
  • Confidence presenting findings, risk summaries, and recommendations to senior management, committees, or regulators
  • An interest in coaching junior investigators and supporting FinCrime capability growth in Brazil
  • Prior exposure to regulatory inspections or audits, including BCB or internal audit follow-ups, with experience presenting control evidence

title: Fund Manager
description:
Fund Operations Manager (AMIF)

Location: Sao Paulo, Brazil - On site

Company: Amicorp Fund Services

Are you an experienced fund professional ready to take the lead in managing complex fund structures, driving operational excellence, and fostering lasting client relationships? Join Amicorp Fund Services , a trusted global provider of fund administration and corporate services, and play a pivotal role in expanding our fund operations footprint.

About the Role

As Fund Operations Manager , you will ensure Amicorp meets all contractual, regulatory, and statutory obligations while actively supporting commercial growth. You’ll oversee the setup and administration of multiple investment funds, manage a dedicated team, and act as a key liaison between clients, investors, and internal departments.

This role blends technical fund expertise , leadership , and a commercial mindset — ideal for someone passionate about both operations and strategic growth.

Key Responsibilities

Client & Deal Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of fund administration clients, fostering long-term, trust-based relationships.
  • Advise on optimal fund structures, legal and regulatory frameworks, and ongoing process improvements.
  • Oversee the drafting and review of commercial, fiscal, and legal documentation.
  • Support fund launches, restructures, and liquidations, ensuring seamless execution and compliance.
  • Attend client and internal meetings to provide technical and operational insights.

Sales & Business Growth

  • Contribute to the commercial growth of Amicorp Fund Services by identifying opportunities and closing deals aligned with business targets.
  • Develop and execute an ambitious sales plan, focusing on expanding relationships with existing clients and attracting new investors.
  • Oversee smooth onboarding and transition management for new clients, ensuring a best-in-class experience.

Operational Excellence & Compliance

  • Collaborate with global accounting teams (India/Mauritius) to deliver accurate and timely fund administration services.
  • Review NAV packages, financial statements, and investor reports to ensure accuracy.
  • Monitor KYC/AML checks, fund compliance, and audit readiness.
  • Maintain comprehensive client records and ensure adherence to all reporting and regulatory requirements.

Team Leadership

  • Lead and mentor the Fund Operations team, ensuring high performance, accountability, and professional growth.
  • Oversee training, performance management, and productivity tracking.
  • Promote standardized procedures, process optimization, and continuous improvement across operations.

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree (minimum) with 15+ years of experience in the investment fund industry.
  • Strong professional network within family offices, investment advisers, foreign investors, and the venture capital community.
  • Proven experience managing teams and fund operations in a fast-paced environment.
  • Expertise in fund accounting, NAV calculations, capital calls, audit processes, and tax fund structures.
  • Strong understanding of IFRS / US GAAP and both UCITS and Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs) .
  • Excellent client-facing, communication, and leadership skills.
  • Commercially driven, proactive, and detail-oriented mindset.
  • Experience with PFX Paxus is an advantage.
  • CGA / CGE certification required.

Why Join Amicorp?

At Amicorp, we believe in empowering our people to lead with purpose, innovate fearlessly, and deliver excellence. You’ll work with a global network of experts, gain exposure to diverse jurisdictions, and be part of a company that values integrity, collaboration, and professional growth.

Join us to make a lasting impact in a dynamic and truly international fund services environment.

✨ Ready to elevate your career and lead with impact?

Apply now and become part of Amicorp’s global success sto

title: Engenheiro/a de mineração, Mina a céu aberto

Engenheiro/a de mineração, Mina a céu aberto

title: Engenheiro de dados SR
description:
A Stone:

Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas! A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no(a) cliente.

Nascemos com o propósito de ser protagonistas na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, servindo o(a) empreendedor(a) brasileiro(a) e transformando seus sonhos em resultados.

Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa RAZÃO.

Como é ser um Egenheiro de Dados:

O Engenheiro de Dados será responsável por construir, implantar e otimizar pipelines de dados confiáveis e escaláveis, garantindo que os dados brutos sejam transformados em informações úteis e acessíveis para a tomada de decisões estratégicas e segmentação de jornadas no contexto de CRM. O profissional trabalhará em estreita colaboração com analistas de negócios e equipes de TI para suportar diversas iniciativas orientadas por dados.

As suas principais responsabilidades serão:

  • Criar e gerenciar pipelines de dados (ETL/ELT): Desenvolver fluxos automatizados e confiáveis para extrair, transformar e carregar dados de diversas fontes, utilizando ferramentas de orquestração.
  • Assegurar a qualidade dos dados: Implementar processos para monitorar a qualidade e a integridade dos dados, identificando e corrigindo falhas na estrutura para evitar comprometimento das análises e jornadas.
  • Otimizar performance: Monitorar o desempenho dos sistemas de dados e implementar melhorias para garantir o processamento rápido e eficiente de consultas e análises.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Linguagens de Programação: Proficiência em SQL (Procedures, DML, DDL, Pipelines) & Python.
  • Plataformas de Nuvem: Experiência com serviços de nuvem (GCP, Amplitude, Salesforce Marketing Cloud) para armazenamento e processamento de dados.
  • Ferramentas de orquestração: Airflow e Cloud Functions.
  • Engenharia de Software: Conhecimento em boas práticas de codificação, versionamento (Git) e testes.
  • Capacidade de Resolução de Problemas e Pensamento Crítico: Habilidade analítica para identificar gargalos, depurar sistemas complexos e encontrar soluções eficazes de forma proativa.
  • Comunicação Eficaz: Clareza para explicar conceitos técnicos complexos para públicos não técnicos (como times de negócios e gestão), e vice-versa, garantindo o alinhamento de expectativas e resultados.
  • Trabalho em Equipe e Colaboração: Atuar de forma integrada com engenheiros de dados, analistas e outras equipes, contribuindo para um ambiente produtivo e sinérgico.
  • Orientação para Resultados: Foco em entregar soluções de dados que gerem valor real para o negócio e impulsionam a tomada de decisões.

Jornada de Trabalho:

  • CLT: 8 horas diárias + 1h de intervalo | Escala: 5x2 Segunda à sexta - de 08h às 17h ou de 09h às 18h.

Modelo/Local de trabalho:

  • Remoto

Etapas do Processo Seletivo

✍Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco realizando seu cadastro e alguns testes. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte!

Entrevistas com o time de People: Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.

Case/ Entrevista com a Liderança: Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências específicas para a vaga. Além de te apresentar possíveis pares e liderança.

✅Check de Cultura: Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia! Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.

Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.

Nossa Cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

⚡Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

- 确保人才梯队的健康构建，满足业务快速发展对各类人才的需求。

3. 绩效管理与人才发展：

- 主导实施绩效管理体系（如OKR），并确保其在本地得到有效落地和优化。

- 建立区域人才盘点机制，识别高潜人才，制定并推动关键人才的培养、发展和留任计划。

- 设计与业务目标紧密关联的培训发展体系，提升员工整体能力素质。

4. 员工关系与企业文化：

- 营造积极、包容、高绩效的企业文化，提升员工敬业度和组织凝聚力。

- 处理复杂的员工关系问题，确保公司在巴西的雇佣实践完全符合当地法律法规。

- 建立有效的内部沟通机制，确保公司价值观和战略在区域内的有效传递。

6. 合规与风险管理：

必备条件：

- 本科及以上学历，人力资源、管理学、心理学或相关专业。

- 10年以上人力资源领域工作经验，其中至少5年以上作为区域HR负责人或高级HRBP，全面负责巴西的人力资源管理工作。

- 具备在高速增长、多变的创业环境中工作的成功经验，能够处理模糊性和复杂性。

- 出色的沟通、影响和协调能力，能够与不同文化背景的各级员工和业务领导者有效合作。

- 卓越的战略思维和解决问题的能力，能够将业务需求转化为具体的人力资源举措。

title: IT Business Analyst - Transportation Management
description:
Position Summary

The Solution Delivery Organization is fully aligned with ADM’s enterprise process framework and the AE/GPO (Accountable Executive/Global Process Owner) structure, supporting business technology strategy development, solution discovery, service management, risk mitigation and relationship management.

Within the Transportation Management (TM) domain, the team enables all processes and capabilities related to planning, execution, visibility and optimization of transportation.

As part of the TM Solution Delivery team, the Senior Business Analyst – TM will analyze business processes, gather functional requirements, and collaborate with Solution Leaders, Process & System Analysts, and business stakeholders to design, document, and deliver robust TM solutions that support ADM’s global strategy.

Job Responsibilities

• Partner with Product Owners, business representatives and Solution Delivery team members during preliminary investigations for new solutions, ensuring clear requirements gathering, data analysis and evaluation of solution options.

• Support business case development by providing process and functional expertise to define expected business outcomes.

• Contribute to the design and revision of processes following enterprise governance standards.

• Understand cross-process and cross-functional dependencies while designing, developing and implementing TM solutions.

• Prepare documentation for key project phases, including requirement gathering, discovery, development and delivery.

• Collaborate with Solution Architects to translate strategy documents into actionable roadmaps and participate in regular roadmap reviews.

• Work closely with other IT delivery teams to ensure efficient end-to-end solution deployment.

• Collaborate with external vendors (software, applications, tools) to clarify business requirements and support system analysts in building functionalities.

• Support roadmap execution for implementation projects, ensuring alignment with stakeholders and service delivery teams.

• Maintain high visibility on solution and service delivery activities through updates, meetings and communication with team leads.

• Analyze incoming requests, ensuring deliverables are well defined and aligned with stakeholders.

• Provide accurate status updates and documentation for assigned projects, enhancements and support activities.

• Contribute to estimates of time and resource needs for proposed solutions.

• Support transition of project deliverables into the support organization through documentation and knowledge transfer.

• Partner with other process and system experts to identify continuous improvement opportunities.

Job Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business or related field, with 5+ years of experience in IT or business process roles.

• Strong understanding of Transportation Management processes (planning, execution, carrier management, freight visibility), and familiarity with major TM solutions.

• Ability to interact professionally with all levels of the organization.

• Demonstrated ability to meet deadlines and work under pressure.

• Ability to work occasional weekends, holidays or overtime when necessary.

• Willingness to travel to support business objectives.

• Ability to work independently and in multicultural teams.

• Strong analytical, organizational, time-management, facilitation and process-management skills.

• Excellent written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills for both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Ability to adapt to fast-paced environments, reprioritize, and handle evolving assignments.

• Knowledge of emerging trends and process solutions related to Transportation Management.

• Fluency in Portuguese and English .

title: Desenvolvedor de Integrações (APIs)
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos a Cipher, uma empresa do grupo Prosegur especializada em Cibersegurança. A Prosegur é líder global no setor em serviços integrados de segurança (vigilância e tecnologia corporativa), monitoramento de alarmes, transporte de valores. Com uma presença internacional em 25 países a Prosegur, proporciona às empresas e lares, uma segurança de confiança baseada nas soluções mais avançadas do mercado.

Se você se identifica com o nosso negócio e propósito, venha fazer parte do nosso time e acelerar sua carreira.

  • Construir conectores para ferramentas de segurança (ex.: autenticação/identidade, gerenciamento de acessos, WAF, SIEM, EDR) e sistemas corporativos (ERP, CRM, ITSM).

Requisitos:

  • Experiência prática com desenvolvimento de APIs e integrações em Python (FastAPI/Flask) e Node.js (Express/NestJS).
  • Experiência com versionamento (Git) e CI/CD (GitHub Actions/GitLab CI/Azure DevOps).
  • Prática com testes automatizados e documentação de APIs (OpenAPI/Swagger).
  • Atuação em Scrum ou Kanban , com participação ativa em dailies, planning, review e retro .
  • Colaboração em code reviews , pair programming e definição de padrões (linters, convenções, documentação).
  • Superior completo em Tecnologia da Informação / Segurança da Informação e afins;

Diferenciais:

  • Integrações com ferramentas de segurança (ex.: Identity & Access, PAM, Firewalls, EDR, WAF/CDN, CASB, etc).

  • Prática com observabilidade (Prometheus/Grafana, ELK/Opensearch, OpenTelemetry).

O que oferecemos a você?

Na Cipher nosso beneficio é flexível VR/VA - Flash

Auxilio Home Office, para dar uma força adicional aos gastos do mês, já que estará trabalhando de casa na maior parte do tempo.

title: Collections Lead
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay. CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.

Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the job

As Collections lead, you will own the strategy that protects liquidity and strengthens trust in the Credix ecosystem. Operations runs the day-to-day recoveries; your role is to define the strategy , policy, and data intelligence that make those efforts precise, fair, and scalable. You’ll guide how we balance recovery and relationships, when to engage, when to escalate, and when to step back.

You’ll refine our existing policy and performance frameworks, turning data into foresight and our network data into leverage - ensuring that Credix’s collections model becomes a competitive advantage, not just a control function.

Qualifications

  • Strong experience in credit recovery in the context of Brazilian SMEs.
  • Proficiency with SQL and BI tools.
  • Ability to interpret cohort data and design actionable segmentation strategies.
  • Deep knowledge of Brazil’s legal and judicial collection frameworks.
  • Clear communicator; able to translate data into field-ready direction.
  • Collaborative but decisive - able to guide Operations while respecting ownership.
  • Pragmatic problem-solver with a bias toward execution.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.

Responsibilities

  • Own the collections strategy and policy across all product lines.
  • Guide Operations: ensure day-to-day execution follows data-backed policy and economic logic.
  • Oversee complex recoveries and litigation, directly managing negotiations on high-value or reputationally sensitive cases.
  • Partner with the Data team to evolve our analytics layer - feeding insights from collections into credit models and underwriting.
  • Optimise the economic model of recovery: continuously measure ROI per effort type and segment.
  • Manage external partners (law firms, collection agencies) with a clear view of cost, compliance, and outcome quality.
  • Report and communicate results clearly to leadership and investors - recovery performance, portfolio health, and systemic learnings.

What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

title: Platform Engineer
description:
Platform Engineer (AWS / Terraform / Kafka) – Fintech Payments Platform

Location: Remote (UK/EU time zones)

Contract: 7 months (to April 2026)

Start: ASAP

Tech Stack: AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes/EKS, Kafka, GitOps, Cloud-Native Tooling

Focus: Platform engineering & solution build (not ops/DevOps)

About the Role

We’re looking for a Platform Engineer to join a major UK retail group building a new Klarna-style fintech payments platform. This role sits at the heart of the cloud platform team and focuses on designing, building, and automating the core infrastructure that powers high-scale financial transactions.

You’ll work in a highly technical environment, collaborating with architects, backend engineers, and security teams to deliver secure, resilient, cloud-native foundations. This is a hands-on build role — not day-to-day ops or DevOps support.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Build & Infrastructure Engineering

  • Design and implement scalable, resilient cloud platform components in AWS
  • Own Infrastructure as Code using Terraform (modular, reusable architectures)
  • Build secure multi-account AWS environments following Well-Architected principles
  • Develop internal platform tooling, automation, templates, and golden paths
  • Support EKS/Kubernetes environments and microservice deployment foundations

Event-Driven & Distributed Architecture

  • Build and support Kafka-based event streaming and messaging capabilities
  • Ensure high availability, reliability, and idempotent service patterns
  • Work with engineers to define infrastructure for distributed, real-time systems

Observability, Reliability & Performance

  • Implement monitoring, alerting, logging, and distributed tracing (Datadog/Grafana/ELK)
  • Ensure SLAs/SLOs for platform components are met
  • Contribute to disaster recovery design, multi-region readiness, and resilience testing

Security, Governance & Compliance

  • Enforce best practices for IAM, secrets management, encryption, and network security
  • Build guardrails, policies, and automated compliance into CI/CD and IaC workflows
  • Contribute to platform risk assessments and mitigation strategies

Collaboration & Technical Leadership

  • Partner with architects, platform leads, and product teams to translate requirements into technical designs
  • Work with developers to guide best practices for cloud-native builds
  • Mentor engineers in IaC, automation, and platform engineering patterns

Skills & Experience

Essential

  • 5+ years in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, or Infrastructure Engineering
  • Strong experience with AWS (multi-account, networking, security, core services)
  • Excellent Terraform skills, building modular and production-grade IaC
  • Solid understanding of Kubernetes / EKS or similar orchestration platforms
  • Experience with Kafka or other event-streaming technologies
  • Hands-on with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, ArgoCD)
  • Strong understanding of monitoring, distributed tracing, and observability
  • Ability to work autonomously in fast-paced, cloud-native engineering teams

Nice to Have

  • Experience in fintech, payments, or high-throughput distributed systems
  • Knowledge of Well-Architected Framework, security engineering, compliance
  • Familiarity with service mesh, API gateways, or serverless components
  • Exposure to Python/Go/TypeScript for automation or tooling

What This Role is Not

  • Not day-to-day ops or support
  • Not traditional DevOps or SRE maintenance
  • Not basic provisioning or infra monitoring
  • Not a junior cloud role

This is a platform build position: architecture + IaC + automation + infrastructure foundations.

Você será o ponto de apoio principal para visitantes, expatriados e seus familiares, garantindo uma transição tranquila e bem estruturada durante sua permanência no Brasil. Isso inclui suporte aos processos de imigração, acomodação, saúde, logística e integração cultural, atuando sempre com discrição, flexibilidade e atenção aos detalhes. Além disso, irá prover suporte à comunicação atuando como tradutor (a) em contextos diversos (reuniões, eventos, demandas pessoais, etc).

Responsabilidades

  • Apoiar processos de imigração junto à Polícia Federal e em colaboração com as áreas internas
  • Coordenar logística de mudança, hospedagem, transporte e pertences pessoais
  • Gerenciar contratos de aluguel e despesas reembolsáveis (escola, condomínio, etc.)
  • Suportar viagens corporativas e eventos internos
  • Supervisionar serviços como manutenção residencial e veicular
  • Oferecer suporte em temas relacionados à saúde, educação e contratos de serviços pessoais para expatriados e seus familiares
  • Atuar com empatia, confidencialidade e organização em todas as demandas

Requisitos

  • Ensino superior completo (cursos de formação na área de Humanas)
  • Coreano: Fluente
  • Experiência com atividades administrativas e conhecimento em ferramentas do Office
  • Desejável ter atuado com atividades de assistência a expatriados e conhecimentos de processos de imigração
  • Inglês: Intermediário (desejável)
  • Habilidade para lidar com informações confidenciais e múltiplas prioridades
  • Perfil proativo, comunicativo e com flexibilidade de horários

title: Analista de CS (Sucesso do cliente)
description:
Descrição do Cargo Estamos em busca de um profissional para o cargo de Sucesso do Cliente na Engerisco | Jornada Assistida & Gestão de Risco. A pessoa será responsável por garantir uma experiência de excelência aos nossos clientes ao atuar como ponto de contato principal, solucionar dúvidas e gerir relacionamentos. As atividades diárias incluem compreender as necessidades dos clientes, fornecer suporte proativo, identificar oportunidades de vendas e colaborar com diferentes equipes internas. Este é um cargo de tempo integral, com atuação presencial na cidade de Cascavel, PR.

Qualificações

  • Habilidades Analíticas: É necessário possuir competências para análise de dados e resolução de problemas, com foco em identificar tendências e propor melhorias nos processos.
  • Comunicação: Comunicação clara e eficaz, tanto verbal quanto escrita, para interagir com clientes e equipes de forma profissional e empática.
  • Atendimento ao Cliente: Experiência em lidar com clientes, garantindo alta satisfação e suporte personalizado.
  • Antecipar possíveis problemas, propondo soluções antes que impactem o cliente.

Monitorar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) relacionados a jornada de trabalho, produtividade, SLA e eficiência operacional.

  • Conduzir reuniões periódicas de revisão com gestores para validar insights e oportunidades.

Remuneração: R$ 2.000,00 + Vale alimentação de R$ 700,00 + Prêmio se alcançar metas.

Escola Internacional de Alphaville, IB World School, contrata Professor Estagiário de Língua Inglesa para Ensino Fundamental (1º ao 5º ano).

Horário do Estágio: 8h às 15h ou 9h30 às 16h30, incluindo 1 hora de almoço.

Estágio Remunerado: Excelente remuneração.

Responsabilidades:

  • Auxílio no processo de ensino e aprendizagem ao professor titular em sala de aula.
  • Acompanhamento e apoio individualizado aos alunos.
  • Preparação de materiais.
  • Auxílio na higiene e alimentação dos alunos.

  • Estudante de Pedagogia ou Letras.

Compromisso com os Princípios de Salvaguarda

A Escola Internacional de Alphaville está empenhada em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens estudantes, e espera que todos os colaboradores e voluntários partilhem deste compromisso.

Todas as pessoas titulares de qualquer função ou cargo estão sujeitos a procedimentos de verificação apropriados, incluindo uma pesquisa para devida diligência, referências profissionais cobrindo o histórico dos últimos 10 anos e verificações de antecedentes criminais satisfatórias (atendendo ao art. 59A Lei no 8069 de 13 de julho de 1990 do Estatuto da Criança e do Adolescente).

A Escola Internacional de Alphaville está empenhada em fortalecer a nossa cultura inclusiva, identificando, contratando, desenvolvendo e retendo colegas de equipe de alto desempenho, independentemente do gênero, raça, orientação sexual, expressão de gênero, idade, deficiência, neuro divergência, origem socioeconômica e/ou outras características demográficas. As pessoas candidatas que compartilham com a nossa visão e princípios, e estão interessados em contribuir para o sucesso da escola através desta função são fortemente encorajadas a candidatar-se à vaga.

title: Líder de vendas
description:
Objetivo e Relevância Global para a Organização:

Contribuir para o alcance das metas de KPI da Loja, proporcionando uma experiência memorável para os consumidores e praticando os Valores da Marca. Apoiar a liderança e as operações da loja como terceiro responsável e gerenciar a equipe designada. Utilizar conhecimento e experiência para vender aos consumidores, atendê-los e alcançar excelência operacional, além de executar operações de loja perfeitamente quando for responsável pelo fluxo de produtos entre a área de vendas, o estoque e/ou o caixa, seguindo os procedimentos.

Principais Responsabilidades:

• Apoiar as operações de vendas da loja e os funcionários como terceiro responsável, cumprindo a função de gerente responsável na ausência do Store Manager e do Assistant Store Manager para assegurar o gerenciamento e a supervisão da loja, garantindo o cumprimento dos padrões de atendimento da adidas.

• Colaborar na obtenção dos KPIs da loja e garantir que a equipe tenha ciência deles e da forma como contribuem, e sugerir ajustes necessários para aumentar a produtividade e a eficiência no atendimento e na área de vendas.

• Contribuir para que as políticas e os procedimentos da loja sejam cumpridos de forma a manter um ambiente de trabalho e de compras seguro e apoiar o treinamento da equipe para garantir os padrões da adidas e reduzir riscos.

• Supervisionar e apoiar as diferentes tarefas da loja (por exemplo, caixa, estoque e vendas), executando-as em conjunto com a equipe, se necessário, para garantir o funcionamento da loja e o atendimento ao consumidor.

• Liderar, motivar a equipe designada e apoiar o recrutamento e o treinamento de outros membros da equipe, fornecendo as ferramentas necessárias para ter performance e atingir os objetivos da loja, garantindo o engajamento dos funcionários, a produtividade e a cultura de alta performance, e liderando pelo exemplo enquanto defensor da Marca, demonstrando consistentemente a cultura para reforçar os valores da adidas.

• Apoiar o Store Manager no treinamento da equipe em todas as ferramentas e soluções de vendas digitais e omnicanais, além de prestar atendimento de pós-venda para garantir uma experiência de compra perfeita.

• Concluir todos os programas de treinamento aplicáveis, incluindo Foundational e Seasonal Brand, além de ter conhecimento sobre o produto, colocando o aprendizado na prática com eficácia.

• Trabalhar sempre priorizando a equipe, em total respeito com todos os colegas e contribuindo ativamente para tornar seu local de trabalho um ambiente inclusivo e acolhedor para todos.

Habilidades e Conhecimentos:

• Conhecimento de todas as ferramentas e processos operacionais da loja, do funcionamento da loja e de como atingir os KPIs.

• Compreensão dos padrões de Visual Merchandising para impulsionar a conversão através de ações estratégicas.

• Conectar, engajar e inspirar ativamente os consumidores.

title: Analista de Gestão de Pedidos
description:
O que você irá fazer:

  • Gestão Inteligente de Estoque vs Demanda: Realizar análises criteriosas de estoque versus pedidos, garantindo a liberação otimizada dos pedidos de acordo com a disponibilidade de supply . Sua expertise será fundamental para reduzirmos progressivamente as restrições de vendas, transformando cada análise em uma oportunidade de maximizar receita.
  • Parceria Estratégica com Comercial: Atuar como consultor interno do time comercial, fornecendo respostas ágeis e precisas aos questionamentos, auxiliando na distribuição inteligente de cotas e realizando análises profundas das previsões de vendas. Seu papel é ser o tradutor entre a capacidade operacional e as ambições comerciais.
  • Centro de Inteligência Logística: Fornecer informações estratégicas de estoque e logística através de análises e indicadores acompanhados diariamente. Desenvolver dashboards e relatórios que antecipem problemas e identifiquem oportunidades, sendo o radar da operação.
  • Gestão Estratégica da Segmentação de Clientes : Ser o guardião da segmentação de clientes, garantindo que a liberação de estoque e definição de roteiros sigam critérios estratégicos pré-estabelecidos.

Ser o responsável por transformar dados em insights acionáveis que direcionem a tomada de decisão.

title: D2C Projects & New Business Manager LATAM
description:
D2C Projects & New Business Manager LATAM | Samsung Electronics

Highlights :

  • Location: São Paulo - SP
  • Type of contract: Permanent contract, Full time
  • Work Modality: On Site

Who are we?

Samsung Electronics has grown into one of the world’s leading technology companies, recognized as one of the top 5 global brands. As a global leader in technology, we are transforming the world with the creativity and diversity of our talented people who drive this transformation.

Our company's success reflects the determination and talent of our people, aligned with our key corporate values: People, Excellence, Change, Integrity, and Co-prosperity. Our mission is to help people achieve the impossible.

We are inspired by what people want to accomplish in their lives and work to create products that empower them in new ways. This drive fuels our innovation.

Join us at Samsung and find your opportunity to do what you can't.

Looking for more? Visit our website or our career page HERE !

Job Description

Together with Samsung LATAM Countries, the role will be responsible for the development, sales and overall performance of the main D2C sales programs and new business projects, leading the following pillars/strategic areas:

  • Sales Operations: Promote eStore capabilities and coordinate key initiatives along with internal platform/product teams or external partners, aiming to achieve D2C main targets.
  • D2C Sell-out Platforms Management: Strengthen LATAM D2C exclusive programs (such as: Trade-in, Co-Branded Card, Extended Warranty, Installation Service), enabling the sales growth and targets achievement.
  • New Business Projects: Define innovative programs based on sell-out platforms such as subscription models and value-added services and draw the commercial strategies to execute and grow them.
  • CRP: Customer Retention Program ambassador in LATAM D2C, engaging all subsidiary in the company’s strategy and promoting the alignment and projects execution with CS and related stakeholders.

Key Job Responsabilities

  • Define, track, report and engage LATAM Countries to implement the regional/global Sell-out enablers strategy, and ensure the main KPIs achievement.
  • Define the sell-out programs sales strategy by working with the business areas to implement the promotional and forecast plan.
  • Ensure the sell-out programs’ financial sustainability while balancing an attractive promotional agenda with business profitability.
  • Support in marketing / UX strategies for the sell-out enablers launch and enhancement, ensuring the correct communication and display of programs for brand consumers.
  • Act as a PMO of regional projects that focus on accelerating D2C performance.
  • Together with Samsung subsidiaries in LATAM, act in the management of partnerships that make up the digital online channel ecosystem.
  • Prospect regional partnerships and co-lead the deployment of those along with the subsidiaries.
  • In conjunction with the IT team, manage the D2C sell-out projects roadmap, responding by the business assessment, development, execution, GTM and usability of the tools.
  • Manage the continuous improvement agenda of the D2C programs, focusing on user experience and increasing of conversion.
  • Integration with CS Team and related areas to promote CRP (Customer Retention Program) agenda in D2C LATAM, engaging eStore Business and Commercial teams to implement the regional strategy.
  • Executive report on sell-out programs strategies and business results.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Administration, Business Administration, or related areas.
  • Experience in Online sales management and digital environment.
  • Experience in commercial department or sales planning.
  • Management/operation of e-commerce platforms.
  • Strong skills in communication and project management.
  • Master presentation and report skills, structured by deep data analysis.
  • Ease in dealing with complex database in Excel.
  • Fluency in English (Spanish is a plus).

Why is Samsung Electronics the place to be?

Join a Global Team

Work with a dynamic and diverse team, constantly interacting with different cultures.

Tackle Big Challenges

Our history is built on overcoming challenges and striving for excellence. Join us in pushing the boundaries of technology and innovation.

Shape the Future

Collaborate in an open, innovative environment where your ideas come to life, creating products that redefine the future.

Make an Impact

Contribute to groundbreaking technologies that improve lives and support communities worldwide. At Samsung, your work truly makes a difference.

Benefits :

  • Comprehensive health and wellness programs
  • Professional development opportunities
  • Opportunities for career advancement
  • Global networking and collaboration

title: Estagiário de Design gráfico (Indústrial)
description:

Atividades:

- Compõe a lista de materiais; elabora procedimento/roteiro de fabricação; suporta tecnicamente o setor de vendas no que diz respeito à imagem dos clientes e suporta tecnicamente o processo produtivo.

- Desenvolvimento de propostas de layout gráfico com base nas imagens e/ou especificações enviadas pelos clientes;

- Elaboração das listas de materiais e roteiros para fabricação de produtos industriais;

- Gerenciamento e atualização da documentação de aprovações dos layouts gráficos;

- Análise, tratamento e resposta para relatórios de ação corretiva (RAC’s) direcionados ao setor gráfico;

- Análises técnicas para liberação de holds;

- Disponibilização de programas para impressão digital;

title: React Software Engineer
description:

Location: Remote in Brazil

Type: Contract

Job Description:

We are looking for a highly skilled Software Engineer with strong experience in Java distributed systems and stream-based processing to join our engineering team You will design build and operate backend services that handle high through put workloads integrate with cloud platforms and support business critical applications

This role also involves working with Nodejs services CICD pipelines and modern infrastructure tooling including Kubernetes GitHub Actions AWS and GCP

  • Design implement and maintain distributed backend services using Java and Nodejs
  • Build and optimize message driven architectures and data pipelines using Apache Kafka

  • Write clean maintainable and well tested code following industry best practices
  • Deploy monitor and support applications running on Kubernetes across cloud environments
  • Work closely with architects and product teams to design system components and integrations
  • Participate in code reviews system design discussions and operational readiness efforts
  • Troubleshoot production issues across services and infrastructure
  • Prototyping of new technologies to reduce cost and increase engineering velocity

  • A BS degree or higher in Engineering Computer Science or a related field is required
  • 5 years of software engineering experience
  • Strong Java experience in backend or distributed systems environments
  • Handson experience with Kafka producers consumers partitions topics offsets stream processing etc
  • Proficiency in Nodejs for backend application development
  • Experience deploying and maintaining services running in Kubernetes
  • Familiarity with GitHub Actions for CICD
  • Handson experience with AWS and or GCP cloud platforms
  • Solid understanding of software design patterns system architecture and microservices principles
  • Experience working with MongoDB and PostgreSQL schema design performance considerations migrations
  • Strong debugging problem solving and communication skills
  • Excellent problem solving critical thinking and communication skills
  • Ability to work within a distributed team

  • VOD Streaming experience
  • Experience with React basic frontend integration work context management UI components
  • Exposure to infrastructure as code tools Terraform Helm etc

description:

title: Data Engineer
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Python Data Engineer with an AI/ML focus to join our client’s growing data & analytics team in Brazil. This role is ideal for someone who loves building scalable data pipelines, operationalizing machine learning workflows, and partnering closely with data scientists to bring models into production.

You will design, develop, and maintain data infrastructure that powers AI-driven insights across the organization, including data models and pipelines that run through Snowflake . This is a fully remote position working with cross-functional product, engineering, and analytics teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build, optimize, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using Python, modern data engineering frameworks, and Snowflake as a central data warehouse.
  • Architect and manage data workflows , ensuring accuracy, scalability, and reliability.
  • Work closely with data scientists to deploy, monitor, and tune machine learning models .
  • Develop feature engineering pipelines , preprocessing workflows, and model-serving APIs.
  • Integrate data from various sources (APIs, databases, cloud storage, streaming platforms).
  • Implement MLOps best practices including versioning, CI/CD for ML, and automated retraining workflows.
  • Optimize data storage, compute usage, and performance within Snowflake and cloud-native tools (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Create and maintain documentation, data catalogs, and operational guides.
  • Monitor data system performance and recommend improvements.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 3–7+ years of experience as a Data Engineer , Python Engineer , or similar backend/data role.
  • Strong proficiency in Python , including building production-grade data pipelines.
  • Experience with Snowflake —data modeling, Snowpipe, tasks, streams, stored procedures, and performance optimization.
  • Experience with AI/ML workflows : feature engineering, inference pipelines, or deploying models.
  • Proficiency in SQL and relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server).
  • Hands-on experience with at least one cloud platform ( AWS , GCP , or Azure ).
  • Experience using data orchestration tools like Airflow , Prefect , or Dagster .
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, Vertex AI , or similar.
  • Strong understanding of data modeling, data warehousing, and distributed systems.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Spark , Databricks , or other big-data processing tools.
  • Experience ingesting and transforming data at scale on Snowflake , including optimization of virtual warehouses.
  • Familiarity with Kafka , Kinesis , or other streaming platforms.
  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, etc.).
  • Exposure to deep learning frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch).
  • Experience working with Brazilian clients or LATAM distributed engineering teams.

title: English Language Specialist
description:
iMerit seeks detail-oriented and analytically minded Multimodal GenAI Evaluation Analysts to perform highly nuanced evaluations of AI system outputs across different modalities: text, image, video, and multimodal interactions. Analysts will assess the accuracy, appropriateness, quality, clarity, and cultural alignment of model outputs against complex guidelines, ensuring that results align with project standards and real-world use cases. These evaluations will directly inform the development and fine-tuning of advanced large language models (LLMs), vision models (LVMs), and multimodal AI systems.

Role Responsibilities:

  • Evaluate outputs generated by LLMs across multiple modalities (text, image captions, video descriptions, and multimodal prompts).
  • Assess quality against project-specific criteria such as correctness, coherence, completeness, style, cultural appropriateness, and safety.
  • Identify subtle errors, hallucinations, or biases in AI responses.
  • Apply domain expertise and logical reasoning to resolve ambiguous or unclear outputs.
  • Provide detailed written feedback, tagging, and scoring of outputs to ensure consistency across the evaluation team.
  • Escalate unclear cases and contribute to refining evaluation guidelines.
  • Collaborate with Project Managers and Quality Leads to meet accuracy, reliability, and turnaround benchmarks.

Skills & Competencies:

  • Strong critical reading, observational, and evaluative skills across different modalities.
  • Ability to articulate nuanced judgments with precision and clarity.
  • Excellent English comprehension (CEFR B2 or above); additional languages a plus.
  • Familiarity with LLMs, generative AI, and multimodal systems.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to apply guidelines consistently.
  • Awareness of cultural and linguistic nuances, including potential bias and harm in AI outputs.
  • Comfort with evolving workflows, rapid feedback cycles, and complex quality frameworks.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree/ diploma or equivalent educational qualification.
  • 1+ years of experience in data annotation, LLM evaluation, content moderation, or related AI/ML domains.
  • Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms.
  • Strong understanding of language and multimodal communication (instruction following in image generation, fact-checking, narrative coherence in video, etc.).
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments.
  • Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training.
  • Prior exposure to generative AI, prompt engineering, or LLM fine-tuning workflows is a plus.

While moderation of high-harm/high-risk material is not part of this role, candidates should be aware that occasional exposure to NSFW or otherwise sensitive content may occur due to imperfections in client-provided datasets. Applicants should indicate that they are comfortable working in environments where such incidental exposure is a possibility.

What We Offer:

  • Opportunities to shape the evaluation standards for next-generation multimodal AI systems.
  • Innovative and supportive global working environment.
  • Competitive compensation and flexible remote working arrangements.
  • Continuous learning and growth in applied AI evaluation.

Join iMerit to help shape the benchmarks and standards that ensure AI systems are accurate, safe, and culturally aware across text, vision, and multimodal applications. If rigorous analysis and innovation excite you, we encourage you to apply!

title: Risk Expert
description:
Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and maintain a comprehensive enterprise risk management framework covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks across the organization.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing、scenario analysis、capital adequacy evaluations and other regulatory-mandated reviews.
  • Prepare, validate, and support all regulatory disclosures required of financial institutions and virtual asset service providers (VASPs) , ensuring accuracy and timely submission.

Margin-Account Risk Oversight

  • Lead the governance and oversight of margin-account operations , including:
  • Establishing risk policies for margin lending and virtual asset collateral;
  • Defining and periodically reviewing maximum LTV ratios and haircut methodologies ;
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons, and counterparty exposures;
  • Ensuring adherence to client and institutional exposure limits, capital buffers, and net-worth thresholds.
  • Continuously monitor key risk indicators (KRIs) across business functions, escalating breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board with clear remediation plans.
  • Operate as an independent second-line function , maintaining objectivity from commercial and trading activities while collaborating closely with Compliance, Finance, Operations, and Technology.
  • Engage with internal/external auditors, regulatory bodies, and governance committees on matters related to risk management, capital adequacy, and prudential standards.
  • Promote a strong risk-aware culture by supporting ongoing training, communication, and enhancements to risk methodologies, models, and documentation.

Requirements

  • Must be legally residing in Brazil.
  • Minimum 7 years of senior-level experience in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within banks, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and proven capability operating as a second-line or independent control function .
  • Strong command of Central Bank of Brazil risk regulations, prudential rules, capital adequacy requirements, and VASP reporting obligations.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks , stress testing, scenario modeling, and margin-account governance involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or a related field; postgraduate qualifications are strongly preferred.
  • Exceptional analytical skills, strong quantitative capabilities, excellent communication, and full professional fluency in Portuguese and English.

title: Senior Manager, Shared Services Center
description:
About the company:

COFCO International is a global agribusiness company that purchases, stores, sells, processes, and distributes essential agricultural commodities: grains, oilseeds, sugar, cotton, and coffee.

Headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, COFCO International employs approximately 11,000 professionals in 37 countries and has assets on every continent, with operations in more than 50 countries.

COFCO International is an agribusiness platform of COFCO Corporation, one of China's largest agricultural and food companies, with global operations.

About the position:

Responsible for COFCO's transactional processes in the areas of Accounting, Tax Calculation, Tax Receipts, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Service Contracts, Freight, and Consumer Account Management, ensuring process efficiency through compliance with the area's KPIs and SLAs.

Main responsibilities:

Develop and implement effective strategies for the SSC, aligned with the objectives of each business;

Identify and implement continuous improvements in SSC processes and systems, with the aim of increasing efficiency and reducing costs;

Collaborate with other functional areas and business leaders to ensure efficient service delivery;

Manage the calculation of federal, state, and municipal taxes, with the aim of collecting debts and/or refunding tax benefits in accordance with current legislation. Ensure compliance with ancillary obligations within the established deadlines;

Ensure the control of service contracts, leases, and similar agreements, from the receipt of the supply process to the termination of the contract;

Manage COFCO's financial control involving Accounts Payable and Receivable operations, ensuring write-offs and controls and advances made to suppliers, following established policies;

Responsible for ensuring all COFCO Freight and Transit operations, from contracting services to accurate entries and payments;

Responsible for seeking efficiency in SSC operations through SLAs agreed with each business leader;

Ensure the accounting reconciliation of COFCO INTL companies in Brazil, aiming to comply with accounting standards and in line with global Controllership guidelines;

Ensure compliance with the budget and manage expenses under your management, in line with company policies and departmental objectives;

Promote continuous improvement and automation of processes under your management and implement the necessary controls to mitigate risks and losses for the company;

Responsible for complying with current laws and internal procedures and being the point of reference;

Seek to unify and standardize transaction processes for the SSC.

Requirements:

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or related fields;

MBA/Postgraduate degree – Controllership, Financial Management, and People Management;

More than 7 years of experience in SSC is required;

Work experience in a multinational company in a matrix environment and in the agribusiness sector;

Solid knowledge of accounting, financial management, calculations, internal control, reports, and financial processes;

Fluency in English;

Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, and PowerPoint);

Experience with the SAP system;

Experience with SLAs and KPIs;

Strong project and process management skills;

Experience with AI and automation, bringing innovative solutions to the business;

Analytical and problem-solving skills with a focus on continuous improvement;

Must have a strong ability to interact effectively with different hierarchical levels;

Effective management and leadership skills with strong verbal and written communication skills;

Proven experience in leading teams in the Shared Services Center area;

Willingness to live and work in the city of São José do Rio Preto.

Please send your resume in English.

COFCO International is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified talent is welcome and considered for our positions, regardless of race or ethnicity, religious belief, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, nationality, age, disability, or other characteristics protected by law.

To learn how COFCO International collects and processes your personal data during your job application, please refer to our Privacy Policy

title: Project Quality Engineer
description:
PROJECT QUALITY ENGINEER

Reports to: Quality Coordinator

Role Summary

- Assists with the interpretation of project-specific Quality Assurance requirements, verifies Quality Assurance plan implementation, and evaluates effectiveness by audits and assessments.

- Responsible for verification of design, procurement, manufacturing, site activities, tests, inclusion of appropriate inspections and their acceptance criteria into project documentation that will be deployed into the Supply Chain.

- Ensure that Quality is being incorporated into projects and processes (prevention), rather than inspected.

Key tasks of the Position

  • Reviews customers’ specifications, further legal / statutory requirements (Q related) and compare to industries standards aiming to identify main relationships and differences (if any), ensure proper requirements' management and compliance.
  • Reviews / issues project-specific Quality Plans and documentation (e.g.: Inspection & Test Plans, etc).
  • Supports, facilitates, reviews and releases project-specific Design & Process FMEAs, verification and validation reports, ensuring proper method application, risk analysis & classification, actions definition and their implementation.
  • Ensure project lessons learned (positive and negative) are produced and management system changes are implemented, as necessary.
  • Supports the development of project-specific sourcing & manufacturing strategies and schedules, ensuring that all relevant quality activities and requirements are considered and consistent to the strategies.
  • Participates on key project related meetings (e.g.: Design reviews) providing quality related input;
  • Ensure through process audits & verifications (e.g., at Engineering, Sourcing, Manufacturing, Field Services) and based on project-specific data analysis that quality is being incorporated in processes.
  • Drives, supports, and facilitates continuous improvement activities (e.g., at Engineering, Sourcing, Manufacturing, Field Services) based on project-specific data analysis.
  • Performs Technical Committee meetings prior components' release for shipping.
  • Supports, review and releases the Project-specific Quality Data book
  • Monitor the Project Quality Budget and to inform the Project Manager and the Project Quality Coordinator accordingly (eg compliance with Sales Forecast value; proceeding in case of deviations).

Additional responsabilities

  • Supports, on demand and based on his/her capabilities, Quality department's tasks & priorities defined by the Quality Engineering Coordinator & Head of Quality
  • Occasional Business Trips: ~ 20% of time

Decision-Making Powers

  • Full empowerment for rejection or blockage of processes and/or components when those are not compliant to the expected Quality requirements.
  • Power of tasks assignment (e.g.: start of a problem-solving activity) based on project-specific data analysis

EMPLOYEE PROFILE

Professional Experience & Education

  • Degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Material, as applicable) or equivalent.
  • Postgraduate in Business Administration (desirable).
  • Relevant work experience in Quality Management & Quality Engineering.
  • Relevant professional experience and knowledge in business processes as well as in non-quality functions like Manufacturing, Logistics, Engineering, Purchasing.
  • Certified Lead Auditor (e.g. ISO 9001 and ISO 19011) (desirable).
  • Qualification in electrical and/or, dimensional and/or, NDT testing (desirable).

Specific Skills & Knowledge (Ex: Language, IT skills)

  • Practical knowledge in using IT-tools: SharePoint, SAP, MS Office, database tracking programs.
  • Good Lean Management background is an advantage.
  • Management and communication skills (incl. but not limited to interpersonal, listening, verbal, written, didactic and presentation).
  • English fluent, written and spoken (additional languages are an advantage).
  • Strong analytical expertise as well as result-oriented, solution driven (pragmatic) and customer oriented working principle.
  • Experienced and willingness to work and cooperate in cross functional teams

description:

Fundada no Brasil em 2020, com sede em São Paulo, a Gruen conta com um time de engenharia atuando tanto localmente quanto na Alemanha o que assegura o desenvolvimento do processo mais eficiente para cada projeto.
