title: Professor de italiano
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!

Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!

A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.

Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.

*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*

O que oferecemos?

  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você .

Necessário:

  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.

O diferencial?

Aqui você é mais que um professor.

Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.

Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.

Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.

Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.

Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

O que eu faço?

  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as

Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.

QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.

Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.

Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Gerente de licitação
description:
Gerente de Licitação:

Garantir a competitividade, conformidade e rentabilidade dos processos licitatórios públicos, assegurando que a empresa participe de forma estratégica e sustentável dos certames, contribuindo para o crescimento do faturamento, a expansão do market share e a manutenção da reputação ética e técnica da organização no mercado.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Gerenciar todo o processo de licitação pública, desde a análise de editais até a entrega e acompanhamento pós-venda;
  • Coordenar equipe de analistas e assistentes de licitação, garantindo cumprimento de prazos e conformidade documental;
  • Assegurar a correta interpretação de editais, termos de referência e legislações aplicáveis (Lei 14.133/2021, pregão eletrônico, etc.);
  • Negociar com fornecedores, fabricantes e clientes para assegurar condições competitivas e margens adequadas;
  • Controlar indicadores de performance da área (taxa de sucesso em licitações, prazos de entrega, faturamento, etc.);
  • Apoiar a diretoria comercial e financeira com análises de viabilidade e rentabilidade dos processos licitatórios;
  • Implementar políticas de compliance e controle documental;
  • Representar a empresa em sessões públicas de pregão e reuniões estratégicas com órgãos públicos.

Requisitos:

  • Superior completo em Administração, Direito, Gestão Pública, ou áreas correlatas;
  • Legislação de licitações (Lei 14.133/21 e correlatas);
  • Excel avançado e sistemas de gestão ERP;
  • Noções em formação de preços e margens comerciais;
  • Noções de tributação aplicada ao setor de distribuição.

Competências Comportamentais:

  • Orientação para o cliente: Apresentar olhar voltado para experiência do cliente e estimular seus pares para o mesmo. Realiza promessas factíveis de cumprir. Fornece retorno ao cliente de acordo com o combinado;
  • Foco em Resultados: Assume responsabilidades pelas entregas e cumpre prazos. Busca soluções criativas para os problemas apresentados. Apresenta visão sistêmica. Consegue administrar a pressão e frustração. Apresenta histórico de sucesso no cumprimento de metas e entrega de resultados. Apresenta disciplina em ser treinado e direciona seus pares para cumprir script de vendas: análise de oportunidade de vendas, venda consultiva, tem bons argumentos e se prepara para as principais objeções;
  • Disposição para mudanças: Investe em seu desenvolvimento técnico e comportamental. Sabe ouvir e modifica o comportamento a partir de feedbacks. É flexível a novas formas de trabalho. Apresenta energia e “espírito positivo”;
  • Comunicação e Relacionamento interpessoal: Comunica-se com clareza e objetividade. Respeita a expressão de diferentes pontos de vista. Mantém bom relacionamento com equipe, pares e superiores; apresentando inteligência emocional no dia a dia.

title: ANALISTA DE TRANSPORTE RODOVIÁRIO - FOLLOW UP
description:
Vaga pra quem gosta de operação na palma da mão!

A GH Solucionador Logístico tem mais de 14 anos rodando o Brasil e fazendo a logística acontecer de verdade. Com matriz em Itajaí e uma estrutura que integra transporte, armazenagem e soluções sob medida, a GH cresceu com um jeito claro de trabalhar: agilidade, precisão e cliente sempre bem informado.

Agora buscamos alguém pra assumir o Follow Up da operação — o ponto que conecta a estrada ao cliente.

O dia a dia é daquele ritmo que só quem vive operação entende:

• Envio de FUP várias vezes ao dia, mantendo o cliente atualizado com informações precisas.

• Alimentação do sistema do início ao fim da viagem, garantindo horários e dados corretos para o FUP automático.

• Contato ativo com motoristas para acompanhar trajeto e antecipar qualquer atraso.

E, claro, benefícios que realmente fazem diferença no dia a dia:

• Convênio com Faculdade — chances reais de crescer profissionalmente.

• SEST SENAT – Saúde e Treinamentos — consultas, programas de saúde e capacitações.

• Plano de Saúde (após experiência) — segurança pra você e sua família.

• Espaço de convivência — alimentação, descanso e jogos.

• Descontos em combustível — economia direta no bolso.

• Seguro de vida — proteção sempre.

• Alelo Multibenefícios — flexibilidade pra usar como preferir.

Se você tem ritmo, atenção aos detalhes e curte acompanhar a operação em tempo real, essa vaga tem a sua cara.

title: Sales Coordinator
description:
The starting pay for this position is $693 USD/month.

About Us

Publicity For Good (PFG) is a U.S.-based public relations firm that partners with purpose-driven, profitability-conscious brands worldwide.

We specialize in working with Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) companies, particularly in the Food & Beverage, Fashion, and Beauty sectors. Our team secures high-impact media placements for clients through top-tier global outlets such as CBS, Fox News, Vogue, and Forbes.

At PFG, we amplify brands that are making a difference. Our focus is on meaningful visibility, measurable results, and long-term growth. We also operate Signal Raptor, a standalone software solution that enhances brand exposure and supports business scaling.

Role

The Sales Coordinator will be responsible for supporting the sales team's operational efficiency by managing administrative tasks, maintaining CRM accuracy, coordinating schedules, and ensuring seamless follow-up processes. This role serves as the backbone of sales operations, enabling the enrollment and closing teams to focus on revenue-generating activities. Success requires exceptional organization, attention to detail, and proactive communication.

Responsibilities

  • Maintain and update CRM with accurate lead information, call notes, and pipeline status
  • Inbound application grading for prospects
  • Schedule and coordinate sales calls, follow-ups, and client onboarding activities
  • Send follow-up emails, texts, and reminders to prospects on behalf of the sales team
  • Manage sales collateral, proposals, contracts, and presentation materials
  • Track KPIs, generate sales reports, and maintain dashboards for team visibility
  • Handle administrative tasks including calendar management, data entry, and file organization
  • Support lead nurturing campaigns and re-engagement sequences
  • Coordinate communication between sales team members and other departments

Results

  • 100% CRM accuracy with timely updates on all lead activities and deal stages
  • Zero missed appointments or follow-ups due to scheduling or administrative errors
  • Consistent tracking and reporting of sales metrics, pipeline health, and team performance
  • Improved sales team productivity through efficient administrative support and coordination
  • Clear and proactive communication with the team on priorities, deadlines, and action items
  • Tangible contribution to revenue goals by enabling the sales team to maximize selling time

Requirements

  • Proven experience as a virtual assistant, sales coordinator, or in a similar administrative support role
  • Strong organizational and time management skills with ability to handle multiple priorities
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with professional demeanor
  • High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy in all tasks
  • Proficient with CRM systems (GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Close, or similar platforms)
  • Comfortable with sales tools including scheduling software, email platforms, and project management systems
  • Self-motivated and proactive with ability to anticipate needs and solve problems independently
  • Reliable internet connection and professional remote work setup
  • Adaptable and quick learner who thrives in a fast-paced sales environment
  • Agency or PR/marketing background is a plus

The starting pay for this position is $693 USD/month.

title: Banco de Talentos - Assistente de Customer Services
description:
Estamos criando um banco de talentos para futuras oportunidades em uma área estratégica que gera resultados para a organização. No momento, não temos vagas abertas, mas queremos manter um canal aberto com você que se interessar e se aplicar.

title: Supervisor de Montagem - Transformadores e Alta Tensão
description:
A CHINT é uma fornecedora global líder em soluções de energia inteligente, oferecendo soluções abrangentes para energia verde, eletricidade inteligente e produtos inteligentes de baixo carbono. Nossa missão rumo à digitalização sustentável desbloqueia novos potenciais no mercado internacional, incubando e fomentando futuras inovações científicas. Ao celebrar seu 40º aniversário, a CHINT está intensificando seus investimentos e expandindo sua presença internacional, com foco estratégico no Brasil e na América Latina. Quer fazer parte desse movimento de crescimento? Junte-se à CHINT!

O Supervisor de Instalação de Transformadores é responsável por supervisionar a montagem de transformadores de alta tensão de acordo com as especificações técnicas, padrões de qualidade e protocolos de segurança. Esta função exige forte liderança na gestão de equipes de montagem, incluindo subcontratados, para garantir que os projetos sejam concluídos dentro do prazo e do orçamento. O Supervisor também precisará solucionar problemas complexos de montagem e manter-se atualizado sobre os detalhes do produto, especialmente a documentação técnica da CHINT, para garantir uma instalação eficiente e precisa. A capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão e resolver problemas rapidamente é fundamental para o sucesso nesta posição.

Algumas das principais atividades incluem (mas não se limitam a):

  • Supervisionar e coordenar as equipes de montagem de transformadores de alta tensão, incluindo equipes internas e subcontratadas.

  • Analisar relatórios de testes de fábrica e realizar todos os testes de comissionamento elétrico necessários.
  • Representar a empresa e manter comunicação ativa com o cliente final em relação a todas as atividades no local.
  • Solucionar problemas técnicos durante o processo de montagem.
  • Estudar e aplicar especificações técnicas, manuais do produto e fichas técnicas, principalmente as fornecidas pela CHINT.
  • Monitorar a qualidade das instalações e garantir a conformidade com os protocolos de segurança.
  • Supervisionar o trabalho das subcontratadas e manter estrita adesão aos cronogramas e orçamentos do projeto.
  • Fornecer suporte técnico e orientação aos membros da equipe.
  • Garantir a documentação adequada dos processos de montagem e das soluções de problemas.

  • Conhecimento e capacidade para realizar todos os testes de comissionamento.

  • Forte capacidade de liderança com experiência em gestão de equipes e subcontratados.
  • Capacidade de ler e interpretar documentos técnicos, desenhos e fichas técnicas de produtos.

title: Data Warehouse Architect
description:
Databricks Data Warehouse Architect About the role:

One of the largest companies in the world in the Gaming industry is seeking a hands-on Data Architect with DataWarehouse Engineer expertise in Databricks (DBX) and AWS-native data services to spearhead the design and implementation of a new data warehouse instance for a major product line. This role will involve building from the ground up—architecting scalable pipelines, optimizing lakehouse performance, and integrating seamlessly with diverse real-time and batch data sources across AWS.

The ideal candidate is passionate about data architecture , thrives in fast-moving environments, and has a proven track record of setting up high-performance lakehouse platforms on Databricks with a strong foundation in data warehousing principles .

Key Responsibilities:
  • Design and deploy a new Databricks Lakehouse instance tailored to the client’s product-level data needs.
  • Architect and implement robust data ingestion pipelines using Spark (PySpark/Scala) and Delta Lake.
  • Integrate AWS-native services (S3, Glue, Athena, Redshift, Lambda) with Databricks for optimized performance and scalability.
  • Define data models, optimize query performance, and establish warehouse governance best practices.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product teams, data scientists, and DevOps to streamline data workflows.
  • Maintain CI/CD, preferably DBX for data pipelines using GitOps and Infrastructure-as-Code.
  • Monitor data jobs and resolve performance bottlenecks or failures across environments.
Required Skills & Experience: Databricks / Lakehouse Architecture
  • End-to-end setup of Databricks workspaces and Unity Catalog
  • Expertise in Delta Lake internals , file compaction, and schema enforcement
  • Advanced PySpark/SQL skills for ETL and transformations
AWS Native Integration
  • Deep experience with AWS Glue , S3 , Redshift Spectrum , Lambda , and Athena
  • IAM and VPC configuration knowledge for secure cloud integrations
Data Warehousing & Modeling
  • Strong grasp of modern dimensional modeling (star/snowflake schemas)
  • Experience setting up lakehouse design patterns for mixed workloads
Automation & DevOps
  • Familiarity with CI/CD for data engineering using tools like DBX, Terraform, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps
  • Proficient in monitoring tools like CloudWatch, Datadog, or New Relic for data pipelines
Bonus/Nice to Have:
  • Experience supporting gaming or real-time analytics workloads
  • Familiarity with Airflow , Kafka , or EventBridge
  • Exposure to data privacy and compliance practices (GDPR, CCPA)
Other Details:
  • Location : Latin America (LATAM) region - Remote, USA - Remote
  • Length : 1+ Year

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Role Summary

The Senior Backend Engineer is a crucial position within Vingcard | ASSA ABLOY, primarily responsible for designing, developing and maintaining robust backend solutions that power our innovative access control systems for hotels and adjacent markets. The role demands a deep understanding of backend technologies, including Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Java, and Kotlin. The candidate will work in a dynamic, cross-functional team to deliver high-quality software that enhances the functionality and performance of our products.

  • Job Location: Brasilia, Brazil

KEY Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and maintain backend applications using Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Java, and Kotlin.
  • Collaborate with frontend developers to integrate user-facing elements using server-side logic.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.
  • Contribute to all phases of the development lifecycle, from design to deployment.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize backend systems.
  • Ensure high performance and responsiveness of the application.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of current backend technologies and best practices.
  • Participate in code reviews, providing feedback and suggestions for improvement.
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance to junior developers, helping them navigate technical challenges and grow in their careers.
  • Ensure adherence to best practices in software engineering, including code quality, testing, and documentation.

Responsibilities And Authorities

  • Authority to make technical decisions related to software architecture and design.
  • Access to all necessary information and tools to perform role effectively.
  • Responsibility for delivering high-quality software solutions on time and within budget.
  • Authority to mentor and provide career development support to junior developers.
  • Reporting to the R&D Manager for project assignments and career development.

Internal and External Contacts/Customers

  • Internal: Work closely with other software developers, QA engineers, product managers, and designers.
  • External: Interact with external stakeholders during product demos or user feedback sessions.

Skills

Key competencies, Relevant Knowledge, skills and competEncies

  • Proficient in Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, and Spring MVC.
  • Strong understanding of RESTful APIs and web services.
  • Experience with observability technologies (e.g. Datadog).
  • Experience with Git versioning systems.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proactive, self-motivated, and able to manage time effectively.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
  • 6+ years of professional experience in backend development.
  • Proven experience with Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, and Spring MVC.
  • Familiarity with Git versioning systems.

Languages

  • Proficiency in English for listening, reading and writing. Intermediate speaking skills in English. Proficiency in Brazilian Portuguese.

Computer Skills

  • Proficiency in software development tools, version control systems (e.g., Git), and Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment pipelines.
  • Proficiency in Java/Kotlin.
  • Deep knowledge of Spring MVC and/or Spring Boot.
  • Proficiency in interacting with relational databases.
  • Working knowledge of distributed architectures and messaging systems (RabbitMQ, AMQP, etc).
  • Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Kubernetes, etc).

Experience

  • Software Engineer, Backend Engineer or similar position.
  • Minimum 6 years of experience.

Personal qualities

  • Strong leadership and mentorship skills.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Proactive and self-motivated, with a drive to take initiative and lead projects.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team.
  • Continuous improvement mindset, with a commitment to staying up to date with the latest industry trends and technologies.
  • Adaptable and eager to learn new technologies and practices.
  • Detail-oriented with a focus on code quality and best practices.

Expected outcome and deliverables -(For the role, on a 3-5 years horizon)

Over the next 3-5 years, the Senior Backend Engineer will contribute significantly to the development and optimization of our backend systems, ensuring they are robust, scalable, and efficient. The role will play a key part in enhancing the functionality of our access control solutions, delivering high-quality software that meets the needs of our customers and stays ahead of industry trends, including launching new products. The individual in this position will have the opportunity to grow professionally, acquiring new skills and taking on additional responsibilities as part of a dynamic and innovative team.

Vingcard Athos Team

The Vingcard Athos team, based in Brasília, Brazil, specializes in developing innovative solutions for the Build-to-Rent market, catering to both long and short-term rentals of furnished apartments. As a small and dynamic team, we manage the entire solution, including IoT devices, backend, frontend, and mobile applications.

We operate on a hybrid work model, with three days in the office and two days working from home. While our primary language of communication is Portuguese, all our code and documentation are in English, and meetings involving other teams are conducted in English.

Our team is an integral part of the Vingcard Research & Development organization headquartered in Sweden. We are thrilled to have you join us!

CONTRACT DETAILS

  • You will be a registered employee (CLT) of ASSA ABLOY GLOBAL SOLUTIONS IMPORTACAO EXPORTACAO DE EQUIPAMENTOS ELETRONICOS LTDA.
  • Benefits include Vale Refeição.
  • Benefits include health insurance (plano de saúde) for you, your spouse and your children at no additional cost.

We are the ASSA ABLOY Group

Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 61,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.

As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.

As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

title: Gerente de Engenharia de Software
description:
Vaga também para PcD!

1. Requisitos Técnicos

  • Capacidade de definir padrões de codificação, versionamento e documentação técnica.

  • Experiência em revisão técnica de projetos, estimativas de capacidade (capacity planning) e métricas de produtividade (lead time, throughput, bugs ratio).

  • Experiência comprovada em liderar times de engenharia (mín. 8–15 pessoas), incluindo POs, Devs, QAs e DevOps.
  • Habilidade em atrair, reter e desenvolver talentos, com foco em crescimento técnico e comportamental.
  • Capacidade de realizar 1:1s, feedbacks estruturados e planos de desenvolvimento individual (PDI).
  • Gestão de performance e alinhamento com OKRs da organização.

2.2. Gestão de Entregas e Processos

  • Domínio de metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe).
  • Experiência com gestão de demandas, backlog e priorização em conjunto com Product Managers.
  • Habilidade em gerenciar riscos, prazos e dependências entre times.
  • Familiaridade com gestão por indicadores (DORA Metrics, Velocity, Burn-down).

2.3. Comunicação e Influência

  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação técnica e executiva, com clareza e objetividade.
  • Experiência em apresentações para stakeholders, CTO e board.
  • Capacidade de influenciar decisões técnicas e estratégicas, equilibrando visão de negócio e engenharia.

3. Diferenciais Estratégicos

  • Experiência em empresas de grande porte ou ambientes altamente regulados (ex: saúde, finanças).
  • Vivência com transformação digital, integração de legados e uso de IA/automação para eficiência.
  • Capacidade de conectar visão técnica ao impacto de negócio, propondo inovações com ROI mensurável.
  • Formação complementar em gestão de tecnologia é altamente valorizada.
  • Conhecimento de idiomas: Inglês para conversação, leitura e escrita

4. Principais Entregáveis Esperados

  • Estruturação do time (organograma, papéis e responsabilidades).
  • Implementação de pipeline de entrega contínua e indicadores de performance.
  • Redução de bugs e incidentes críticos.
  • Aumento de produtividade e previsibilidade das entregas.
  • Melhoria contínua na qualidade técnica e satisfação da equipe.

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.

Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.

As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including:
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral;
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels;
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons, and counterparty exposures;
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institution limits and capital requirements;
  • Net-worth monitoring.
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.

Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

title: Operations Manager
description:
Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide.

Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards.

Our Brazil Office is currently seeking a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager to join our dynamic team.

Main Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

Operational Leadership

  • Efficiency and Compliance: Guide the team in operational excellence through regular training and adherence to work instructions, ensuring timely responses, accurate reporting, and proper use of the IRIS system, Integrated Management System, and all company policies, processes, and procedures. Overall responsibility for leadership and support, which enables the team and Region to meet and surpass KPIs and Quality Metrics.
  • Training and Development: Conduct initial and ongoing training for QC Coordinators (QCCs), maintaining minimal errors and supporting development. Ensure the gap analysis assessment is completed for all new starters and, as needed, for experienced coordinators.
  • IRIS Compliance: Oversee IRIS accuracy and compliance for the Region, ensuring client and inspector profiles, rates, assignments, and reports are up-to-date and meet Fulkrum standards. Operations Managers should become “super-users” of IRIS, driving continuous improvements throughout the team and the business.
  • Financial Oversight: Improve cash flow and reduce the Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) by supporting Accounts and managing invoicing challenges between departments, reducing errors and minimising un-invoiced visits, ensuring POs and approvals are received on time, supporting credit control escalations, and reporting issues promptly and consistently to Senior Management. Identify areas for improvement between coordination and accounts, suggest process improvements, draft Corrective Action Reports (CARs), and support cash flow and credit control objectives.
  • Budget Management: Support the Regional Manager in budget maintenance, report on client activity levels, and drive financial efficiencies. Monitor and manage office expenses and personnel utilisation. Recommend improvements to the Regional Manager.
  • Gross Profit Targets: Ensure gross profit objectives by overseeing client and inspector negotiations, minimising reliance on agencies, and upholding service standards.
  • Growth and Client Engagement: Collaborate with Sales to highlight Fulkrum’s capabilities and successes, recommend growth opportunities, and support the acquisition of new clients and service lines. Present IRIS and Fulkrum’s strengths in client meetings to support business development.
  • Client Retention: Schedule reviews with key clients, addressing service quality and identifying any gaps for improvement. Maintain client relationships through regular communication and promptly address any issues to ensure satisfaction. Report concerns to the Regional Manager as needed.
  • CRM and Reporting: Document client interactions in Salesforce, compile monthly reports, and highlight successes, challenges, and key client insights for the Regional Manager.
  • Overhead Management: Regularly assess team workloads to maintain operational efficiencies, minimise redundancies, and support overhead budget goals. Propose staffing adjustments to the Regional Manager as required.

Team Development

  • Recruitment and Onboarding: Collaborate with HR to recruit and onboard new team members, ensuring resources and support are ready for a smooth start.
  • Performance and Probation Management: Lead 30-, 60-, and 90-day reviews for new hires, ensuring development aligns with company standards. Conduct regular performance evaluations and address skill gaps through targeted training.

Compliance & QHSE

  • Process Optimisation: Act as a “process expert” within Fulkrum, supporting the Integrated Management System (IMS) and continuous process improvements. Collaborate on IRIS developments and provide training for each improvement.
  • Focal Point: for QHSE and Compliance during internal/external audits, draft and implement CARs as necessary, support all IMS initiatives for process improvements.

Commercial

  • Proposal and Contract Support: Support bid preparation, draft project-specific execution plans and procedures, create/approve rate sheets, perform contract renewals, and support all other commercial requirements as needed.
  • Insurance and Compliance: Coordinate insurance documents, bank letters, and tax documentation, ensuring sufficient coverage for client projects.

Team Culture and Engagement

  • Team Building: Foster a positive and inclusive office culture, organising team events and maintaining a supportive environment. Promote retention through effective leadership and engagement initiatives.
  • Engagement: Drive any engagement survey initiatives and follow up on global, regional and local actions to ensure continuous engagement of the team.

Client Account Management

  • Client Service Reviews: Schedule meetings with key clients to evaluate service quality and implement corrective actions as necessary.
  • Business Development Support: Assist the Regional Manager and Key Account Managers in bidding, negotiating contracts, presenting to prospective clients, and identifying new business opportunities.
  • Growth and Forecasting: Monitor project forecasts, ensure proper onboarding of new clients, and communicate budget impacts to the Regional Manager and Finance Department.

Coordination Responsibilities

  • Client Support: Manage client requests for QA/QC, Engineering, and Project Support, ensuring prompt and accurate fulfilment.
  • Candidate Management: Source candidates, prepare them for interviews, and coordinate their placement, handling contractual and performance-related concerns throughout their assignments.
  • Service Level Agreements: Ensure adherence to all client SLAs and Fulkrum KPIs, negotiating inspector rates to support office margins.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Minimum 10 years of industry experience, with 5 years in a leadership role.
  • Extensive knowledge of oil and gas projects, both onshore and offshore.
  • Proficient in MS Office; CRM experience preferred.

title: Senior Installation Analysis Engineer
description:
Job Overview:

The Senior Installation Analysis Engineer uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve the Installation Analysis discipline within McDermott. They will act as a resource for colleagues with less experience and share their conceptual and practical expertise related to the Installation Analysis discipline. The Senior Installation Analysis Engineer solves complex problems and uses discipline-specific knowledge to improve their products or services. The Senior Installation Analysis Engineer impacts a range of customer, operational, project, or service activities with the Installation Analysis team and other related teams and ensures they work within the appropriate guidelines and policies.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Perform conceptual, FEED, and detailed design as per design basis, project specifications, design codes, and standards
  • Direct Engineering team when assigned as a Project Coordinator on projects
  • Apply knowledge and skills to a wide range of standard and nonstandard situations
  • Prepare clear and accurate detailed design calculations and analyses including design reports and procedures
  • Manage own time to meet agreed deadlines and budgets and develop plans for short-term work activities in own area
  • Communicate and explain complex issues and work to establish understanding
  • Provide engineering support onboard installation vessels offshore, when required to do so
  • Be fully familiar with the project scope of work, specifications, schedule, and all inter-discipline requirements; including identifying concerns as early as practicable and taking appropriate initiatives to address the issues
  • Identify changes to scope and promptly raise change notifications, including providing any necessary supporting documentation and estimates Provide similar support for Variation Orders
  • Interface with all disciplines to develop clash free designs
  • Interface with other departments to obtain input for discipline designs and drawings
  • Maintain close cooperation with other engineering disciplines, Planning, Fabrication, Marine, and Project Management Teams, as required
  • Document substantive communications (communications that result in significant decisions or assignment of actions) and forward copies to the Discipline Lead Engineer
  • Assist in the preparation of estimates for bid proposals, including technical query reviews, execution statements, and workhour estimates
  • Raise technical queries to obtain missing information, clarify work scope, and maintain preferred McDermott procedures, specifications, standards, practices, and operational requirements
  • Prepare Discipline engineering design basis, philosophies, and technical specifications, as required
  • Participate in finalizing deliverables lists and deliverables, ensuring compliance with specifications and functional integrity
  • Attend project review meetings, vendor meetings, engineering meetings, and offshore site surveys, as required
  • Provide technical direction and review of Designers producing products related to Construction/Installation Support Engineering
  • Prepare and review design reports
  • Assist in providing necessary design inputs to other disciplines to enable them to proceed with their deliverables
  • When assigned, assist procurement personnel in producing Discipline equipment, materials, and services; ensuring that work produced complies with customer objectives and procedures Procurement assistance includes preparing and reviewing requisitions, evaluating technical quotations and preparing queries, compiling bid tabulations and recommendations, preparing purchase requisitions, and coordinating with Procurement to expedite vendor documents, as directed by Discipline Lead Engineer
  • Assist in updating weight report based on receipt of vendor information
  • Check engineering performed by others within the Discipline
  • Perform design verification through single-discipline check/inter-discipline check (IDC)
  • Provide technical support to all fabrication queries, including identifying defect/rectification requirements
  • Keep the Lead engineer apprised of all activities and concerns, technical, budgetary, and manpower related
  • Assist in providing inputs for actual, planning, and forecasting progress reports including associated productivity
  • Participate in internal, Customer, and third-party technical audits on engineering deliverables and vendor documents
  • Assist Lead engineer with responses to Customers and other agencies (such as certifying authorities, auditors, third parties, etc.) on their review and approval
  • Capture lessons learned and enter into MDR’s Lessons Learned system
  • Act as a resource for colleagues with less experience
  • Guide less experienced engineers on MDR and Discipline procedures, standards, worksheets, design calculations, software, requisitions, technical bid evaluations, technical queries, etc.
  • Be aware of costs related to own work and of the discipline
  • In the Pipeline installation discipline, perform/review Pipeline Installation Engineering designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures for transportation and installation:
  • Submarine pipelines
  • Risers
  • Spools
  • PLETS and manifolds
  • Cables
  • In the Structural Installation discipline, perform/review Structural Installation Engineering designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures for loadout, transportation, and installation of offshore structures, including barge upgrades/modifications
  • In the Naval Installation discipline, perform /review Naval Architecture Engineering designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures related to all aspects of marine operations covering loadout, transportation, and installation
  • Additional skills (preferred, not mandatory) - perform/review designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures such as:
  • Erection sequences for jackets, topsides, and other structures
  • Loadout procedures and guidance during the operations
  • Construction lift analyses and procedures for activities such as floatover, stackings roll-ups, etc.
  • Weighing procedures
  • Design and detailing of miscellaneous fabrication yard items
  • Crane arrangements and rigging arrangements
  • Trailer arrangements/operations, including drawings and procedures

Reports to: Discipline Lead Engineer

Liaise With: All Engineering disciplines, Fabrication Group, Safety Dept, Document Control, Procurement Group,

Subcontractors, Project Management Team, Vendors, and Customers

Supervises: Engineers

Essential Qualifications and Education:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Naval Architecture, Civil/Structural/Mechanical Engineering (Master's degree preferred)
  • 8-15 years of experience in oil and gas with a major contractor or consultant predominantly performing construction and installation design
  • Strong working knowledge of many design techniques and analysis methods, and detailed knowledge of the content and application of standards codes and guidelines as applicable for onshore and offshore construction
  • Preferably Registered Professional Engineer or member of a professional engineering society

description:

title: Data Engineer
description:
Job Title: Data Engineer

Location: Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: Full Time

Compensation: Competitive hourly rate, commensurate with experience

About Design Manager

Design Manager (+DesignSpec) is a leading provider of project management and accounting software tailored specifically for interior design firms. For over 30 years, we’ve helped thousands of designers run more efficient, profitable businesses with our cloud-based platform that integrates purchasing, budgeting, time tracking, and client communication in one seamless solution. As we grow, we're investing heavily in our data infrastructure to enhance product capabilities and improve client outcomes.

About the Role

We’re seeking a skilled Data Engineer to support our product and technology team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for building and maintaining data pipelines, analyzing data, and enabling data-driven decision-making across the organization. You'll be the first and only dedicated data analytics team member , so we’re looking for someone with an entrepreneurial mindset who is comfortable operating independently, defining structure, and solving complex data challenges.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL processes
  • Clean, validate, and structure raw data from various sources to ensure data quality and usability
  • Analyze large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights that support business decision-making
  • Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations to communicate key performance metrics to stakeholders
  • Work cross-functionally with teams (e.g., finance, operations, marketing) to define data needs and solve business problems using data
  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams to understand and meet data requirements
  • Develop data models and schemas for analytics and reporting
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize data pipelines for performance and reliability
  • Support the design and implementation of a modern data warehouse architecture
  • Ensure data quality, governance, and security best practices are followed
  • Work with third-party APIs and internal tools to extract, transform, and load data
  • Demonstrate an entrepreneurial, self-starter attitude as the inaugural data analytics hire

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in data engineering or a related field
  • Proficiency in SQL and experience with Python or another scripting language
  • Experience analyzing large datasets and generating insights that drive business impact
  • Familiarity with dashboarding and analytics platforms such as Mode, Power BI, or similar
  • Hands-on experience with modern data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift)
  • Experience with ETL tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt, Fivetran) and data pipeline orchestration
  • Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts and data modeling
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with minimal oversight

Nice to Have

  • Experience in SaaS or B2B software environments
  • Exposure to finance or accounting domains

Why Join Us

  • Competitive hourly compensation
  • High-impact role with significant autonomy and visibility
  • Opportunity to shape the foundation of data and analytics at a growing SaaS company
  • Collaborative and mission-driven team environment
  • Possibility for contract extension or full-time conversion based on performance and business needs

description:

Para isso, você será a linha de frente, analisando as necessidades dos clientes, projetando a solução, configurando os fluxos fiscais, e fornecendo sessões de treinamento . Basicamente, você será responsável por fornecer a melhor solução de gerenciamento fiscal/contábil aos seus clientes, prestando suporte interno com as demandas fiscais e tributárias necessárias para facilitar os negócios dos nossos clientes, apoiando PMEs de diversos setores a extrair o máximo valor da Odoo. Atuamos com foco no usuário, de maneira ágil, dinâmica e sempre pensando no longo prazo.

Responsabilidades e dia a dia:

  • Gerenciar o relacionamento com os clientes durante a implementação do Odoo.

  • Atuar diretamente em contato com o P.O. do produto de Localização Brasileira para apoiar em especificações técnicas e testes de funcionalidades e bugfixes.

title: Analista de RH (R&S e DP)

Departamento Pessoal (DP):

  • Administrar os benefícios corporativos (Vale-Transporte, Vale-Refeição/Alimentação, Plano de Saúde, etc.).
  • Garantir a conformidade legal de todos os processos trabalhistas.
  • Atuar como interface entre a empresa e os colaboradores para esclarecimentos de dúvidas sobre folha e benefícios.

Recrutamento e Seleção (R&S):

  • Realizar todo o ciclo de R&S, desde a abertura da requisição até a integração do novo colaborador.
  • Divulgar vagas em portais e canais especializados.

  • Realização de entrevistas por competência e fit cultural.
  • Elaboração e apresentação de propostas comerciais (offer).
  • Acompanhamento de indicadores (KPIs) de R&S, como tempo de fechamento, custo por contratação e turnover.
  • Manter um banco de talentos ativo e organizado.
  • Garantir uma experiência positiva do candidato durante todo o processo.

Atividades Gerais de RH:

Requisitos e Qualificações

Obrigatórios:

  • Formação completa em Administração, Psicologia ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência em funções generalistas de RH, com vivência sólida e comprovada em Departamento Pessoal e Recrutamento & Seleção .
  • Conhecimento avançado na legislação trabalhista e previdenciária (CLT).
  • Experiência prática com sistemas de folha de pagamento (Dominio, TOTVS, SAP, Senior, etc.).
  • Conhecimento intermediário/avançado do Pacote Office (Excel para elaboração de relatórios e planilhas).

Desejáveis:

  • Experiência anterior atuando in house (diretamente alocado no cliente).

title: Frontend Developer (Angular)
description:
In SOTEC Consulting - Astek Group, we are seeking an Angular Front-End Developer with strong experience building real-time, data-driven web applications. The ideal candidate is a frontend specialist with deep expertise in Angular, complemented by hands-on experience as a Java developer working with APIs and microservices.

If you enjoy delivering high-performance, scalable user interfaces in technically challenging environments, we want to hear from you!

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain web applications using modern Angular .
  • Collaborate with backend teams and contribute to the development and integration of Java-based APIs and microservices .
  • Ensure smooth communication between front-end and backend services (RESTful APIs, JSON, etc.).
  • Optimize application performance for speed and scalability, especially in data-intensive or real-time scenarios.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code following best practices.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to real-time rendering and UI responsiveness .
  • Stay updated on the latest trends in both frontend and backend development.

Must-Have Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 8+ years of professional experience in front-end development with Angular .
  • Experience implementing real-time data features (e.g., ag-Grid or similar tools).
  • Hands-on experience as a Java developer , especially with microservices (Spring Boot or similar frameworks).
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3 .
  • Experience integrating RESTful APIs and working with JSON.
  • Familiarity with responsive and adaptive design principles.
  • Experience using version control systems ( Git ).
  • Strong communication skills in English (minimum B2 level) .

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with state management libraries ( NgRx, Akita , etc.).
  • Familiarity with containerization technologies ( Docker, Kubernetes ).
  • Experience with data visualization libraries (e.g., D3.js, Charts ).
  • Exposure to Agile/Scrum methodologies.
  • Experience in financial services or other real-time, data-intensive industries.
  • Interest or experience in UX design and tools like Figma or Adobe XD .
  • Strong communication skills in Spanish .

title: Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor Role
description:

About Downstream

Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision: bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.

We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.

The Role

We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI/UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.

At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to:

  • Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.
  • Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.
  • Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast: prototype, test, iterate, and refine.
  • Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.

Responsibilities

  • Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.
  • Build and maintain UI/UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.
  • Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.
  • Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.
  • Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.

What We’re Looking For

  • Battle-tested designer: You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).
  • AI-forward mindset: You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.
  • Builder’s DNA: Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.
  • Technical & design skills:
  • UI/UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus: Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)
  • Startup mentality: Hands-on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.
  • Industry experience: Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open-source design systems or AI products.

Why Downstream

  • Early-stage, high-growth startup with real traction.
  • Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.
  • Opportunity to shape AI-native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.
  • Competitive salary + equity

  • Acompanhar SLAs de contatos, follow-ups, acordos e compromissos assumidos.
  • Mapear riscos de cancelamento e agir preventivamente para evitar churn.
  • Alimentar o CRM com histórico, status, acordos e próximos passos, mantendo previsibilidade e organização.
  • Colaborar com times internos (CS, financeiro, comercial e operações) na construção de rotinas que melhorem retenção e adimplência.
  • Gerar percepções qualitativas sobre comportamento dos clientes, objeções recorrentes e oportunidades de melhoria no produto/atendimento.

  • Disciplina e compromisso: acompanhar pendências, prazos e acordos até a resolução.

Empresa especialista em impulsionar vendas no varejo por meio de tecnologia, dados e automação. Democratizamos o acesso ao marketing digital para o empreendor do Brasil profundo!

O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 5+ years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.js and experience with either Golang, Node.js, or Java, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will play a foundational role in building the core platform that enables power utilities to shift from decades-old legacy systems into an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and APIs to ensure seamless integration of intelligent functionality into the client's products.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.

Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development : Build, implement, and maintain front-end applications
  • Back-End Architecture & Development : Design, implement, and maintain APIs, services, and distributed systems that form the backbone of the client's OS
  • AI Integration : Collaborate with AI engineers to integrate models, embeddings, and agent services into back-end systems. Operate AI APIs, ensuring outputs are production-ready and aligned with enterprise utility requirements.
  • System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices
  • Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default
  • Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments
  • Strong proficiency in React, Python, and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams
  • Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.g., calling APIs, integrating model outputs)
  • Solid understanding of databases (SQL and NoSQL), message queues, and distributed architectures
  • Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams

Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry

Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Podcast Producer
description:
Podcast Producer (Full-Service Management) – Sofia Health

Full-Time | Remote | Long-Term Role

Sofia Health is looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Podcast Producer to manage the full production workflow of our weekly interview podcast, Sofia Unfiltered . This role handles guest communication, scheduling, episode preparation, editorial coordination, and project management from pre-production through publishing.

We interview physicians, psychologists, authors, wellness experts, and thought leaders. You must be able to communicate professionally, manage multiple moving pieces, and maintain a calm, supportive tone consistent with our brand.

⭐ What You’ll Do (Responsibilities) Guest Communication & Outreach
  • Manage all communication with guests from initial outreach to post-episode follow-up
  • Schedule interviews, send confirmations/reminders, and provide prep materials
  • Collect bios, headshots, books, links, and required release forms
  • Draft guest outreach emails and pitch new guests aligned with upcoming content themes
  • Maintain guest pipeline, schedules, and assets in Notion/Google Drive
Episode Planning & Production
  • Prepare episode briefs and host prep sheets
  • Attend live recordings (optional but preferred) to track timestamps and notes
  • Review raw audio/video and provide clear, detailed edit notes to the editor
  • Restructure episodes when needed for clarity, flow, and narrative arc
  • Collaborate on episode titles, angles, hooks, and story direction
  • Choose main promotional clips and quotes for social content
Editing Coordination
  • Send the editor cut notes that are clear, accurate, and time-stamped
  • Review first edit, request revisions, and ensure quality before publishing
  • Ensure the final episode reflects brand voice, pacing, clarity, and guest experience
Publishing & Show Management
  • Write compelling show notes, descriptions, summaries, and timestamps
  • Prepare publishing assets (titles, tags, categories, episode artwork if needed)
  • Upload weekly episodes to our hosting platform (Spotify for Podcasters or similar)
  • Track episode performance metrics and maintain publishing calendar
Marketing & Promotion Support
  • Coordinate with the social media team to deliver clips, quotes, and captions
  • Identify promotional opportunities through guests’ audiences
  • Support the creation of audiograms, reels, and short-form content briefs
Monetization & Growth
  • Assist in creating sponsorship decks and packages
  • Research relevant brand partners to pitch
  • Coordinate guest cross-promotion to increase downloads
  • Identify podcast swaps and collaboration opportunities
  • Track growth trends and propose strategies to expand reach
Host & Media Outreach (Podcast Guest Booking)
  • Research aligned podcasts across wellness, entrepreneurship, marketing, leadership, mental health, women’s health, lifestyle medicine, and business growth
  • Create a list of high-quality podcasts suitable for Riley as a guest
  • Draft personalized podcast pitches in Riley’s voice
  • Send and manage outreach emails to podcast hosts and producers
  • Track outreach, follow-ups, and confirmed appearances in Notion or a CRM
  • Coordinate scheduling, prep materials, and talking points
  • Prepare Riley with a one-sheet, interview brief, and relevant episodes of the host
  • Identify opportunities for backlinks, newsletter swaps, and co-marketing
  • Track results and optimize pitches based on acceptance rates
You’re a Great Fit If You…
  • Have real podcast producing experience (required—not entry-level)
  • Have excellent written English and can write in a warm, professional tone
  • Are organized and reliable with strong project management skills
  • Love structure, systems, checklists, and keeping details tight
  • Can communicate confidently with high-profile guests
  • Can listen to an episode and identify what needs to be cut for clarity and flow
  • Are comfortable giving editors detailed, accurate instructions
  • Enjoy managing timelines, assets, and follow-ups
  • Can work independently and solve problems proactively
  • Are calm under pressure and able to meet weekly deadlines
⭐ Required Skills & Experience
  • 2+ years experience as a Podcast Producer , Podcast Manager , or similar
  • Experience working with audio/video editors
  • Strong writing and communication skills
  • Ability to review episodes and give editorial direction
  • Experience managing guests and scheduling interviews
  • Familiarity with publishing platforms (Spotify for Podcasters, Buzzsprout, etc.)
  • Strong organizational skills with tools like Notion, Trello, Asana, or Airtable
  • Comfortable coordinating social media assets
  • Ability to work in US time zones when needed

Bonus:

  • Experience with sponsorship outreach or monetization
  • Background in wellness, psychology, health, or coaching content
  • Experience producing long-form interview-style shows
  • Ability to identify clips for short-form video

Essa função exige sólidos conhecimentos técnicos em logística para avaliar especificações, negociar com fornecedores e alinhar as atividades de compras às necessidades operacionais e estratégicas.

Ele/Ela se reportará ao Diretor de Compras Sub-Regional e trabalhará em estreita colaboração com as fábricas e os especialistas locais em Compras de Transporte, a fim de garantir a continuidade do fornecimento e a competitividade das licitações dos fornecedores.

  • Identificar, qualificar e desenvolver fornecedores estratégicos para operações logísticas (transporte, armazenagem, embalagem, equipamentos e materiais).
  • Realizar análises técnicas e comerciais de propostas para garantir a conformidade com as especificações e padrões de qualidade.
  • Negociar contratos e termos comerciais, visando otimizar o custo total e o prazo de entrega.
  • Monitorar os indicadores de desempenho dos fornecedores (SLA, qualidade, pontualidade, custo), conduzir análises de negócios e estabelecer ações corretivas conforme necessário.
  • Colaborar com as equipes técnicas e operacionais para garantir que as compras atendam aos requisitos logísticos e de produção.
  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de compras que reduzam riscos e aumentem a eficiência da cadeia de suprimentos.
  • Manter atualizado o banco de dados de fornecedores e o mapeamento de mercado.

title: High Ticket closer
description:
ABOUT US

Property Leads is a premium Pay-Per-Lead company that generates high-quality, inbound, motivated seller leads for real estate investors. We are a team of ambitious, results-driven individuals with bold goals for both our company and our personal growth. While many companies describe themselves as a family, we see ourselves as a high-performance sports team, focused, competitive, and committed to winning.

We're looking for someone who is motivated, friendly, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is ready to take on challenges head-on.

THE ROLE

We’re hiring a dynamic and driven Sales & Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team. This role is responsible for selling motivated seller leads to both inbound and outbound prospects, managing their pipeline, and serving as a key point of contact in our customer journey.

This is more than just a sales role, as you’ll be the first impression of Property Leads. Professionalism, strong communication skills, great English, and the ability to build rapport quickly are essential. You should be passionate about helping people succeed and eager to grow within a fast-moving organization.

This role is best suited for individuals with at least one year of experience in commission-based sales.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Conduct onboarding calls, schedule new appointments, and nurture leads in the pipeline
  • Manage and optimize our CRM to enhance lead tracking, segmentation, and conversion
  • Analyze lead data and provide actionable insights to improve sales and outreach
  • Ensure timely follow-up and accurate documentation of all client interactions
  • Work closely with the Sales Manager to drive performance and refine processes

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 1+ years of commission sales experience
  • Strong
  • 1+ years of CRM management experience, ideally in real estate or lead generation
  • Proficiency in CRM platforms (e.g., GoHighLevel) and Airtable
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • This role requires strong proficiency in both written and verbal English. You should be comfortable drafting emails, participating in meetings, and handling client interactions.
  • Self-motivated and collaborative with a strong sense of accountability
  • Self-aware and heavy emphasis on constant self-improvement.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Competitive base pay with performance-based bonuses
  • Remote-friendly work environment
  • Clear paths for career advancement and professional development
  • Supportive, high-performing team culture

title: Analista de Inteligência Artificial
description:

• Responsável pela identificação de soluções e oportunidades de integrações entre os sistemas;

• Responsável pera verificação da viabilidade técnica e econômica para implantação da IA;

• Responsável pela manutenção da IA, através do monitoramento e análises constantes do funcionamento.

O que esperamos do nosso Analista de Inteligência Artificial:

• Disponibilidade para atuar no modelo presencial em Campo Grande/MS;

• Ensino Superior Completo em Análise de Sistemas, Ciências da Computação, Sistemas da Informação ou em áreas relacionadas à tecnologia.
